title: Let me book a lodge that wasn’t available
review: Booked a short break in a lodge for husbands birthday which was 3 week away. Booking process was all fine and paid the money by card which went straight through . Next day got a call from the owner of the lodge to say that those dates shouldn’t have been available and my booking would be cancelled and  I needed to contact Hoseasons to get a refund . Straightforward process on the chat to speak with someone who arranged the refund however it takes 5 working days to get the refund and with it being Xmas will be more like 10 days. I have booked another lodge but had to pay for that one too , not the easiest thing to find another £500 at this time of year. On my banking app I can send money to any other UK bank account holder within 2 hours so why can’t Hoseasons refund me the same day ? Better refund process needed especially when it’s not my fault !

title: I booked a holiday to leysdown with my…
review: I booked a holiday to leysdown with my grandchildren.Whilst on the whole we had fun. Two nights before we were due to depart, we had no water from 4pm. Some 15 hours later there had been no information as to why there was no. We were not advised as to what was going on until I went to the office 9am. I found the communication appalling we had two children with autism. One type 1 diabetic and a six month baby. So not being able to flush the change no drinking water I found this totally unacceptable. I wrote to hoseasons pointing out the issues we had. The response was the holiday park had informed everyone and supplied water. Well certainly 15 hours later with no water or information about what was going on we had not been supplied with information nor any water. Asked hoseasons to ask when the holiday park notified everyone as this was not true as of 9.39am when I approached the office. Where I was told they didn’t know when the water would be turned back on. We could take a small bottle of water to get it filled up from there small supply.I believe they should have at least had notes sent to all holiday homes.

title: Experience getting Worse!
review: I have booked and enjoyed many, many dog friendly cottages, chalets etc. over the years with Sykes. However over the last few years, probably since COVID, the accessibility of customer services agents, the lack of a comprehensive web site, you seem to promise free dog friendly cottages, then they are not free! If there is a problem, that would likely take a quick conversation to resolve becomes an impossible feat, thereby exacerbating an easily remedied issue. An example of my latest (current holiday in fact) the year was wrong on the search, my fault I had been researching a holiday for 2025, then booked another in 2024 and didn't notice the year, which resulted in the wrong year booking. It took hours and even days to get that changed, with threats of losing my deposit, having to pay the full amount, the list goes on. Granted it eventually got resolved, no compensation was offered for all my calls, time it took to get it sorted, it made me want to boycott Sykes in the future!

title: We have just returned from a cottage in…
review: We have just returned from a cottage in the Lake District, where we experienced quite a few problems. On arrival, we couldn’t get the central heating to work, the temperature in the cottage was 11C, bitterly cold. It took, 4 phone calls and over 24 hours to get someone out to us, a further 2 hours for the plumber to sort out the problem (the 3rd time, he’d repaired the same thing!) and several more hours before the accommodation reached a comfortable temperature. Xmas Eve, we couldn’t get the oven to work, no instruction book, so no idea what the problem was. We knew the make of the oven, but no idea of the model, all the identifying marks had worn off. Telephoned the office at 3.30pm, office closed for the Xmas holidays, phoned the emergency number, nobody available, left a message as instructed by the answer machine, nobody ever got back to us!Boxing Day, the shower sprang a leak, there was more water in the kitchen than in the bathroom. No point phoning anyone, on Boxing Day, we knew what the response would be!!Unfortunately, we’d already booked another accommodation with the company, but after that, there’ll be no more.

title: Poor experience
review: We were due to stay at Primrose near Wells.  Having booked and paid for a 3 night Christmas break back in July we arrived on 24th Dec to find Primrose dirty and very untidy - obviously not cleaned after the previous occupancy. I contacted the owner who said he was unaware that we had booked for 24-27 Dec. He said he needed to make a call. 10 minutes later he came outside to tell us that we could stay in their other cottage - Marigold - as this had recently been occupied by just 2 people and was therefore easier to get ready for us. I was travelling with my 85 year old mother who is not too well and I needed to get her inside so spent a rather uncomfortable hour with the owner cleaning around us - this was OK but not how we had hoped to spend Christmas Eve. I’m still not sure why these problems occurred but it was all a bit upsetting. As my mother said - it felt like our balloon had been burst. Having said all of that we did have a pleasant 3 night stay at Marigold. It was warm, comfortable and well equipped and I’m sure Primrose would have been the same. I understand that mistakes happen but it was not how we wanted our long planned Christmas break to start. I submitted a review via the link that was sent to mr but it was not published as I had not stayed at Primrose I have used cottages.com on numerous occasions but this has now made me very wary!

title: Poor service when something goes wrong
review: Having used cottages.com for years, our most recent booking was the first time something has gone wrong. We travelled to the property as a party of eight and immediately found the house was freezing. After trying the heating and contacting the owner, we found there was no power to the boiler and therefore no heating bar a few plug heaters for a very large house. The house was also not as described on the site (it was advertised, and still is, as 3 bathrooms despite only having two). The owner was extremely unhelpful so we contacted cottages.com. In the end we all had to travel home, we had waited hours and had no sign of a resolution so couldn’t risk waiting any longer and being stuck overnight in a house with no heating. (It was sub zero outside). Cottages.com did refund us but when we asked to be compensated for our travel and fuel (no more than that), they were extremely bad, saying the refund was compensation! They did not acknowledge or address any of the issues we had with the property and kept saying it was ‘our choice’ to leave - suggesting we could have stayed in a house in sub zero temperatures with no heating. We’ve been really shocked and disappointed by them and have lost faith in the company, certainly won’t be using them again unfortunately

Location is perfect for walkers, direct access to the canal that leads to Talybont.The pubs were never open in the village, but there is a delightful cafe and village shop. Don’t do to the Usk hotel/ b&b very rude. Google describes it as a hotel its not it is just rooms and the owner was not very forgiving when we turned up seeing if they served food and drink. Rather than saying no sorry, he was very abrupt through his roof top camera and forgot to deactivate when he used bad language at us with a 8 year old present. We digress and is nothing to do with this property. The location is perfect, close to Brecon and other towns. Good bus links to them from the A40. As already advised to our host, the only disappointment is the property is described as having a hot tub. They are not hot tubs, they are lazy spas which lacked maintenance. For that reason it did not get 5 stars. Everything else was perfect.Communication with the host was excellent. We are hoping to return in February and April.

The end wall in the single room is also wet and has black mold around the socket and skirting which is not healthy for guests atall as its next to the head of the bed. I hazard to guess that either the guttering or downpipe outside are the cause of the problem but I've not checked that.The hot water boiler was constantly cutting out whilst having showers and during washing up after meals and at best was only warm not hot, we had to boil the kettle to wash up efficiently. The inside door to the fridge is badly rusted so not very hygienic. description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Not worth the £2k + price for 4 night stay
review: Not worth the £2k + price for 4 nights! I expected more from a luxury priced property - it is sparsely furnished and equipt from Ikea. In the living area there are no tables for drinks. With young family this was problematic- putting glassware on a tiled floor - thankfully no accidents yet but not a great set up.  Lighting in the living area- 1 small lamp for a large room or the bright lights on. Not very atmospheric or homely. Floors all bare- no rugs of any kind in any room. I was under the impression the house would be decorated for Christmas- it wasn’t. I am Disappointed as we came with family for post Christmas celebration’s. The Kitchen ill equipped.  Not enough cutlery for everyone. I had to source extra.  There is a 2 slice toaster for a house that sleeps 8 people. Breakfast time it was a timely affair. Only wine glasses or water glasses, no champagne flutes for New Year’s Eve or celebrations. There is a washing machine but no where to actually hang wet clothes. No table coverings in case of food that could stain wood work. One thing they certainly would want replaced if the table was stained. The light in the hallway doesn’t turn off- faulty light switch. The bathrooms have new locks that can be opened from the outside. The sofa is torn from previous families. The rental company told me there were no sofa beds, in fact there are two. They also stated no high chair, there is one available. Towels are also included we were told to bring our own. No access to the garage. I have never stayed in a property where you could not access the garage to put bikes , prams or bags ect. The garden is not enclosed- for family with young children and pets it was very inconvenient for safety. No side gates and open to the fields.  The hot tub also exposed to passing neighbours and in full view. Check in was very late. The website stated 4pm but email 5pm. I have never stayed in a cottage where we couldn’t access by 3- 4pm latest.  I have rented many houses over the years for holidays. I feel that the property does not live up the expectation of a premium priced retreat.  The owner is missing a trick- it’s a lovely house but sparcley furnished. The house is for sale and it’s obvious that it has been furnished on the cheap.

Only comment is, I wish we can have full access in Saudia website to manage bookings like choosing the seats especially when it's a paid seat, couldn't see on the system but GLITCH all the time & website keeps asking for code which couldn't be sent on my email, just weird. Hoping for a smooth check-in and no issues🤞

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: All’s well that ends well.
review: To be honest I did have problems at the start as it seemed as though I had to contact the airline rather than Crystal handling everything. However, Olivia Clark, at Crystal recognised my frustration and managed everything. She called me once arrangements were sorted and then followed up with emails to make sure all was well.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Alfred restored my faith in Crystal travel
review: Initially, I found the website was rubbish and whenever I tried to get hold of customer service I got a recorded message saying "no one was available, goodbye". Eventually by clicking "1" as if I wanted to buy a ticket I got through to Alfred Shaw who was most helpful and stayed on the line until he had sorted my problem (no receipt for payment or ticket references). Thanks Alfred, before I got through to him I was beginning to think it was a scam. But he restored my faith in  a company I had used before.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Very helpful company Called the company to book tickets to…
review: Called the company to book tickets to LA and was met with some extremely helpful staff. Looking forward to travelling next year with out any problems. Thank you Crystal Travel

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Company you can trust…
review: Very supportive team especially sherry smith..it’s a good and reliable company when booking holidays and flights..you can also pay your flight tickets in instalments depends where you are going and how much..will definitely use them again and again

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: I was talking to James Smith on 03…
review: I was talking to James Smith on 03 November 2024 looking to book a Flight from Dubai to London. James was very helpful trying to get me right ticket for within my budget. He met my expectations well and over.I had wonderful experience with your company and especially dealing with James Smith very helpful and big shout out to him well done.I have used your company on numerous occasions and will do in future. Carry on the good work.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: I’ve booked with Crystal Travel before…
review: I’ve booked with Crystal Travel before and have had no issues whatsoever. They came up with the right flights, all with the help of Shirley Smith, who was helpful, accommodating, polite and very patient.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Pleasant first time encounter..
review: I called on the off chance to enquire about flights to Africa with a payment plan. Claire was so pleasant and asked the relevant questions to answer my enquiry. She offered to search for flights and sourced the best price. She patiently searched other flight options and made good suggestions. Booking was effortless and well informed. Glad I went with my instinct

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Advertise the lowest airfare but then…
review: Advertise the lowest airfare but then once you’ve given details the booking gets denied and they want you to call so they can sell you a more expensive flight. 3 stars because the site is easy to use

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Excellent service
review: We are very pleased with booking our  USA tickets at the final critical moment.very friendly and reliable customer service ,whoever required help Ask for James Smith,very good understanding person. Just keeping 2 stars save for later after visiting the destination.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: I was initially informed by Jose that I…
review: I was initially informed by Jose that I did not have to include second first name of passenger. This lead me to incur an additional cost of £105. Further contact with Alice was polite and helpful. Suggest that at initial contact tat all relevant information is fully checked.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Confirm tickets cancellation  without reason
review: Everytime booked and confirmed tickets get cancelled. Crystal team suddenly informs us by mail that  its by the airline and the we end up taking flights on undesirable dates and time which causes us inconvenience and lost of time we can spend at the destination. This has happened twice in a year. Too bad. Crustal team should take some responsibility and arrange tickets as per our needs.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Finally got the convenient flight
review: It has been weeks trying to get new flight times after the airline cancelled the original flight. I was told I had to pay more airport tax for the flight with a short stop over when I had already paid this for the original flight. The only flight we could get at first without paying extra had a 10 hour stop in Vienna. After a lot of phone calls/messages the operator finally got us new flight times with a short stop with the same airline on the same day without us having to pay any extra!

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Their kind approach and helpful attitude BUT BE AWARE WHILE BOOKING AS TICKETS MIGHT BE NON REFUNDABLE AND IF YOU WILL HAVE TO CHANGE DATES , THAT CAN COST YOU WAY TOO MUCH.
review: First thing made me trust crystal travel was their office address., I m booking my Tickets with crystal travel. All team is very cooperative, helpful and kind but I always book ticket. 🙏🏼 BUT BE AWARE ABOUT TICKETS BEING NON REFUNDABLE AND ANY CHANGES IN DATES WILL COST YOU WAY TOO MUCH.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: The price quoted for our tickets were…
review: The price quoted for our tickets were put up while booking, what the price was and by the end of booking it said those tickets are sold out and the new price was 20£ extra per ticket.Never believe the price it says when you are about to book a ticket with them

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Another case of bait and switch
review: Another case of bait and switch.  The price for the Virgin Economy Light shown via Kayak was switched to the next one up when we went to the Crystal website - in total this would have been a difference of an extra £110 for two travelling.  We booked directly with Virgin Atlantic instead and paid £25 extra in total but still got the economy light fare.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Exploitative and dishonest
review: Incredibly disappointing and exploitative behaviour when I tried to change a flight. Was quoted a whopping £1600 for a “fare difference” when a one way flight was £1200. I went to the airline and had my flight changed for £200 fee which I was told would have been cheaper if Crystal had done so. To me the dishonesty has put me off ever using them again.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: I thought it will be an excellent service but then…
review: I’ve been booking my travel back home with Crystal travel since and this is the first time im travelling back home again after pandemic. Abix is excellent he helped me through formalities, with the booking and through payment. Abix was also very clear with details he sent by email BUT he didn’t send the eticket via email on the day like what he promised. I called the next day another agent promised I should recieve the email atleast 30mins, but no update not no email recieved. I have been chasing this for 2 days, little did I know the person who assist me is now on leave.To make my long story short, Stella who managed to assist me properly assured me I’ll get what I asked for on the day. Stella made sure my concern/query will be looked at and sorted. I don’t really want to write negative feedback but I have to.Thank you stella for the patience and well done.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Dishonest marketing of flexible tickets
review: Dishonest - I booked a flexible business class ticket and was told there would not be any change fees other than fare changes. Turns out that the way they book the ticket is in a fare class that is not available once you change the ticket. They admitted this to me once I asked them to find any date in the future that would not occur an additional fee. When I tried to move the flight to a day earlier the final price should not have changed because the tickets had not gone up in the meantime, but they charged me a substantial amount and much more than the airline would have charged if I had just booked a flexible ticket directly. Dishonest marketing of flexible tickets - beware if that is what you’re looking for.EDIT: the team at Crystal Travel followed up with me multiple times to improve the situation and ended up refunding over half of the increased cost.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Everything was OK in terms of booking
review: Everything was OK in terms of booking, however, I did ask extra luggage with payment, your staff member promised me to come back with furthermore information  but nothing happened till I called back and been told by another member of staff to pay double than I was previously told

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Site is wonky as hell
review: Site is wonky as hellWhat I think is happening is KAYAK is caching some old prices, customers come though, instead of the website being like NOPE here's the new price, it lets you try and book.Only during payment stage the availability of the tickets are actually checked and crashes out if unavailable.Customer support offered to rebook at a higher price, fair enough - it happens, except... that their own home page was cheaper than what they quoted???So I did exactly that, and it all went though booking a second time...Next problem was the conformation email was saying hand luggage only. Quick check with customer support, I do indeed have the hold baggage I paid for and BA also confirmed this.Defiantly have screenshots as you purchase, luckily I did.Overall happy, but was a stressful hour. They do seem to be trying despite their software issues

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: It was good although selecting my dob…
review: It was good although selecting my dob proved an issue as the automatic year wax 2008 and u thought I had changed it but it did not register.  Thankfully Josh was on the phone with me and was able to change to the correct dob but my title remains Miss instead of Mrs

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: A plesant first experiance with Crystal Travel.
review: David Brooks who made the initial booking for us is an agreeable and polite gentlemen who stayed quite late in the evening to ensure booking is confirm and e-Tcket issued. Thomas Salvador was at hand late evening to asssist sumitting special service request to the Airline. Both deserve five stars but let down by the  Crystal Travel web site which seems a bit tricky to understand and  negociate.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Frustrating Experience
review: 18 Aug I found interesting offers from Crystal Travel through my online research and decided to book with them. It was a frustrating experience as I tried several times and always got the message "booking declined", even using different credit cards. It sounds like one of those "too good to be true" situations...24 AugThe company contacted me and apologised for the issues I encountered. They promised it would not happen again. I have already gotten my ticket from a different vendor, but am changing my rating to 3 stars. However, if I encounter the same problem in the future that will be reflected in my rating.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Not enough clearness in taking…
review: Not enough clearness in taking insurance and totally unhappy with a reported no show ridiculous but new flights available at 1900 on top of the 1700 lost.....not happy! People helpful but could do a lot more

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: The good and bad
review: The good: best prices for booking, and i got there in the end. I even got a call to verify the booking (when it finally worked)The bad: Website is iffy at best. Doesnt work at all in firefox. first attempt with chrome just failed at payment stage with no explanation, leaving me not knowing if id paid ot not.Follow up call whilst nice, was difficult to understand and the giuy became quite pushy about filling in this feedback form.I would use again but you've got some basics to work out here.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: 5 Star Rep
review: 5 Star customer service rep! However, their system needs improving as after initially booking and attempting payment, I was informed that no seats were available. I was contacted via telephone and completed my booking with a customer service rep. He's a 5-star! Very helpful!

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: The good side is that the guy i spoke…
review: The good side is that the guy i spoke to on the phone was helpful and patient,the flight is now booked and so far everything seems straightforward.The not so good is originally the flight cost £70 less.i did it online and sent my credit card details to pay this was immediately declined,i then receive a phone call from Crystal Travel saying they couldn't do it at that price because sold out but could do a upgrade(upgrade of what i don't know)for £70 more on the same flight.Was the original price genuine as declined immediately ? Is it a tactic to get you on the phone and offer a higher price than quoted,if so it worked because i booked with them!!

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Sketchy Experience
review: Thankfully we were only booking flights to Amsterdam less than £200, anything more expensive and I would've been very uncomfortable!I received a call to make our booking, despite trying to do it online. Our handler was a chap called "Ronnie O'Connor" despite having a thick Indian accent, which feels dishonest. His English level was poor and he barked instructions at us which we were struggling to understand, which isn't a reassuring situation when there's money involved.He then sent us an email link to a 3rd party payment site. Again, not sure why I wasn't allowed to go through the booking process online like any other travel company. We were both very skeptical about the process and how unprofessional it had been.Thankfully our tickets were real and we went on our holiday, but I definitely won't be using them again for the sake of saving a few quid. Avoid!

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Stop misleading customers
review: Stop misleading customers. Stop advertising cheaper fares !!Never available..always unable to book....total bullshit

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Just Scammers
review: Do not be scammed by this bunch. Once to try booking your booking is declined ( tried 3days in a row) for not having the seats available at the stated price. Someone will then call you back and tell you only the next level of ticket is available but it’s more money( they blame the airline ) even though the price stays the same day after day. Cheap Flights should be banning these companies from doing this because I know I’ll never use them again and I’ll stick with Skyscanner. Never an issue in 10 years with them. Unfortunately I can’t put up all the pictures I took over the past few days to show and prove their lies and deceit. TRUST me use another company other then them

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Prices not live.
review: Several attempts to book flights and entered all details to be told tickets were unavailable. Then seemed to be lots of phone calls to sell alternatives.Uses Expedia instead and had confirmed seats within minutes.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Most competitive price there was…
review: Most competitive price there was Problems with the site re making the payments wasn’t helped by waiting until the office had opened. Nice people but communications were difficult and it took far too long to sort out the payment. Payment form was too clunky imo

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Have never been able to successfully…
review: Have never been able to successfully complete a booking online. One is usually prevented to continue at some stage. This time i tried to make the booking during closing time. the next day I requested a web initiated call back to discuss the booking and the agent said the price was no longer the same. he also said that possibly the price showing had not been updated and offered to book for a higher price.I declined the offer and went back on the web , the original price was still available and I successfully booked it online

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Agent booked an extra night and never told me
review: After numerous phone calls I gave up on this company who changed my return date without informing me which ended up costing me an extra night hotel and car hire in America.  Numerous phone calls to Merritt Lynch who just fobbed me off and blamed BA.  BA told me that the date had always been booked for the different day I was told.  Sometimes it pays to go with a more expensive agent.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: Trying to con the public with "dynamic pricing"
review: Advertised two business class flights Heathrow to Cape Town for a total of £3089. When booking flights, right at the end the payment was "declined". The agent phoned me and informed me that the flights as advertised were unavailable due to "dynamic pricing issues". The price I was then offered was £4750 for the two tickets, or £4064 for flying the day before. This was clearly an attempt to fool the customer into accepting the day earlier flight, which was over £900 more than the advertised flight. It is obvious from previous reviewers that this is a common practice. While discussing this with the agent, I opened a separate window on the laptop and  sourced the flights on the day I wanted to fly directly through the airline for £3500. Although this was more than the advertised price, it was still over £500 less than this outfit tried to con me out of.Update 7/11/24A supervisor and manager both contacted me yesterday to apologise for incorrect information supplied by the booking agent, and additional training would be provided for the particular agent who dealt with the request. The manager indicated that I could be offered the flights for nearly the price originally indicated on the website. This would entail cancelling the booking with the airline and incurring cancellation charges which, ultimately, would not result in any savings. I have been offered a £100 discount voucher, valid for 6 months, as an apology. Based on these interactions, I have raised the rating from 1 to 2 and will give the company another look when booking my next flights. While it is appreciated that the team has reached out to address the issue, the end result is me having to pay more for the flights, through a different provider, than was advertised.  The rating is based on the satisfaction with the desired outcome i.e. the purchase of the air tickets at the price advertised. Unfortunately the response after the event, no matter how good, has little bearing on not meeting the expectation.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: The telephone operator has strong…
review: The telephone operator has strong accent so I couldn't understand what he saying. And after I booked tickets, they charge money 2 times and refund such a mess...and took so long to get eTicket. Worst freaky moment I've ever had. Never wanna use this service again.

description: Crystal Travel is one of the UK's largest independent travel agencies
title: I was unable to book seats online on
review: I was unable to book seats online on one of the flights for my trip to Australia so I contacted Crystal Travel and spoke to Shally. She booked the seats for me and I paid the required amount to do so. Unfortunately, when we checked in online different seats had been allocated and there was no facility to alter them. I spoke to Shally this morning, she said that I must have changed them (certainly not true) and wouldn’t give me a refund. I will not be using this company again!

title: Apartment is nice but some deeper problems
review: At first the apartment seemed lovely, it was cosy, clean and nicely decorated. The location is great and nearby loads of nice food and drink spots. There are plenty of things provided, but no chopping boards or dish washing sponge - necessary things. There were 2 proper drinking glasses provided - one had a huge crack in it so unable to use it. The wifi was not good at all, hard to actually get it to let you connect to it and then it kept disconnecting and reconnecting itself - so there was really no usable wifi. The window in the bathroom it directly in front if the shower and outside the window are other peoples windows. The blind for this window next to the shower was broken. When we arrived it would not move up or down, allowing everyone to see into the window where we were showering - especially bad at night when outside is dark so if we had the light on to shower everybody could see everything. This curtain was also broken with pieces falling out, and after we checked out the host requested a lot of money from us for these damages - damages which were already there when we checked in. The check in and check out process is awful. You have to collect the keys from a store a 15 minute walk away from the apartment. After checking out, you then have to return these keys to a store, when we arrived at the store to return the keys it was closed! We text the host to tell them is was closed and seek help and another option. They did not reply for hours. Thankfully after waiting half an hour at the shop the owner of the shop turned up to let us in.

review: Great location, close to underground and to groceries/restaurants. Quiet bedrooms, firm mattresses. Clean. Reasonably well-equipped kitchen, but typically poor knives. The light over the bathroom mirror was out - I couldn't see to shave. There was masking tape on the bathroom baseboards and towel rack from the last time the room was painted. title: Appalling Experience
review: Booking TY4FGUJVPArrived at the apartment to discover that the information provided for gaining entry, was completely non-sensical. The keys were supposed to be in a keybox, next to the apartment window. As the apartment was on the first floor, this seemed unlikely, but apparently the keybox was close to a bicycle and a flowerpot. After spending quite a while searching for such items, we drew a complete blank. After several calls to GuestReady we finally located the keybox attached to a guardrail by the side of the road, a significant distance from the property and with no bicycle or flowerpot in sight!On gaining entry, we had to navigate our way through a pitch black lobby to a lift whereupon pressing the button, the light went out and we were back in darkness. The lift didn't seem to be working and the immediate thought that we were now trapped in the lift, causing even more stress. Fortunately, we found out how to make the lift work, but ultimately discovered that this problem occurred every time we used the lift.We exited the lift, again in complete darkness, to be confronted with a door that could only be opened if the door was pulled towards one, whilst the key was being turned.We really didn't need all of that completely avoidable aggravation after travelling for fourteen hours!On settling into the apartment, we discovered there were absolutely no instructions on how to use any of the appliances supplied and several essential items of kitchen equipment were either missing or faulty.We also discovered that a significant part of the wall in the sitting area was badly damp and was covered with black, furry mould. The cooker and the fridge hadn't been cleaned properly and a corner of the balcony was filthy and full of rubbish.The following morning we awoke to find we had no water and that situation remained until lunchtime. On Monday morning, of the second week, we awoke to find we had no hot water and that situation remained for several days, meaning we had to take cold showers and I had to boil water in the kettle, in order to shave. Ultimately we were without hot water for more than half our stay.Finally, the lights in the lobby were fixed, but there were still no lights on our floor for several days afterwards.We called GuestReady numerous times throughout the visit, but couldn't get an answer most of the time and out of about ten emails we sent to them, we got no confirmation of when the problems would be fixed, apart from a reply, promising to fix all of the problems AFTER our departure; a lot of use that was to us!GuestReady didn't address any of the problems, save advising us to buy replacements for the missing kitchen essentials, for which they would reimburse us, but that really shouldn't be the responsibility of the guest. I don't know whether the lights and hot water were eventually fixed as a result of their intervention, as we got no tangible response whatsoever about those problems.The apartment itself is spacious,very well laid-out and well designed. It would warrant five stars if it hadn't been for all the problems, but unfortunately they seriously tainted our stay.We have rented apartments in Marseille about a dozen times over the last nine years, with few problems, but this was the worst experience by far and we will never use GuestReady again.Since I posted this review, GuestReady have agreed to refund 30% of the rental fee, which is great, so I have added an extra star to the review and would now consider using them again but nonetheless, that doesn't alter the negative effect all of the problems had on our holiday.

title: Glasnevin Charm near DCU review
review: Gutted after reading such amazing Guestready reviews in general, my stay in Ireland wasn't anywhere near the experience I thought I was paying for or what other people had. I was bringing my mums ashes home to Glasnevin cemetery as her final resting place to be with her parents and brother, so I selected this premises based on location. It's hard to be polite given the number of issues we experienced for the price paid but I will try, however I have to be honest in what was found during our stay.The front and back garden was untidy and very unkempt. Pulling up on arrival, I was mortified. There were no curtains on any windows, the blinds were either broken or didn't block any light out. The water pump was horrendously noisy every time you ran a tap so washing your hands through the night was a no no incase you woke the house. The back door did not lock properly according to the brief instructions. To be clear, nobody from Guestready seemed to understand ths the keys only working in ONE back door, which was the one you close first, before the main door beside could be closed...for which the keys provided did NOT fit into the lock. The reply to this review again doesn't seem to understand this. It shouldn't take more than 2 minutes to work out how to lock a door, so we had to carry our valuables with us for the stay. The mugs and plates were chipped, so there wasn't enough mugs for the 7 of us at one time. The cooker was in Czech so we couldn't use it, one of the windows was so dirty, I were embarrassed we persuaded our family to stay with us so we took that room and gave them the bigger room. There was no dining table, just a coffee table with dining chairs around, out of date food left in the cupboard, nappies in the bins outside which stank whenever you opened it to put rubbish in, and a hoard of cigarette butts in the back garden which we had to clean up. Constructively, I think there should be a welcome pack which would help paying customers on things like explaining how to use the cooker given there was no manual available (the communications received from Guestready were not correct to the type of cooker in place so we just used the hob), useful local info for buses to city centre to save on expensive cabs places to eat, emergency numbers in the event it was needed...simple things that would have really helped us. The company were quick in response over issues until I pushed over the concern for the back door when the communications stopped. They did advise they would sort reimbursement once I had completed the check out. I'm disappointed however that since being given a reimbursement, I haven't been messaged to advise this. I only noticed when I checked the account. Feels like sour grapes. I think at the very least I should have got the cleaning fee reimbursed as this wasn't done very well. The best thing about the stay was the clean bathrooms. They were immaculate so can't fault that, but I have to be honest and say that was the best thing about it. Either the cleaning company are not telling the truth and doing Guestready a disservice or there genuinely isn't the care for ensuring the presentation and upkeep of the properties are in place by landlords. Its a shame that it put such a taint on a very sensitive trip. I won't ever have to book a trip like this again thankfully, however I certainly wouldn't recommend this property unless Guestready put some proper checks in place and improved it's current condition.

Pilot told us that we needed to get off the plane and EasyJet would send buses to transfer us to Krakow.  2 hours we waited outside Ostrava Airport only to receive an automated message on EasyJet App (screwed if you weren't checking it...) telling us that we needed to make our own way to Krakow and claim "reasonable costs".  Arrived at our hotel at 16:30 (should have landed in Krakow at 08:40..) after taxis in Czech Republic were refusing to take us given the distance, took us over 2 hours to find a taxi driver willing to transfer us.  We had booked tickets to Saltmines for 17:00, but due to EasyJet abandoning us in Czech Republic the money I spent on these tickets was wasted as we did not have time to travel to Saltmines.  Then to top matters off, our private transfer home (booked through EasyJet) cancelled at 22:00 on 31st (in Polish...) and we had to book an urgent Uber from hotel to Krakow Airport and almost missed our flight home.  Made a claim for the transfer cost from Ostrava to Poland only to receive an email back stating that I would not be being reimbursed because "EasyJet do not provide reimbursement".Customer service is just absolutely shocking!  No direct communication from EasyJet confirming we needed to make our own way so had I not have activated my mobile data to be able to check the app, we would have stood at diverted airport for hours waiting for the bus which was never arriving!  Then to refuse to pay the reimbursement after the app specifically stating that they would be reimbursing.. And I am still waiting to be told by EasyJet that my transfer back to Krakow Airport was cancelled!  The whole thing was just an absolute shambles.  I lost my entire first day in Poland and was only there for 3!The two stars

I hope that if I ever have to phone again I get someone who is happy to book my holiday and help me through any questions I have.

title: Disappointing Booking Experience – Baggage Issue Needs Resolving
review: Writing this review as I had an email from Travel Republic asking for feedback.I found the initial booking process straightforward and reasonable. After selecting my options (hotel room, baggage, etc.), I proceeded with the payment. The final page clearly outlined the full breakdown of costs, including the package price, transfers, baggage, ATOL protection, and a discount for being a new customer (I had a voucher code sent over email). Payment went through without issues, 30 minutes later I received a confirmation email with my booking reference and a PDF attachment.However, when I reviewed the confirmation email, I was surprised to see:1. 0 bags listed (despite selecting baggage during booking).2. The payment summary only included the total holiday price, balance paid, and a split of payment dates, but didn’t specify the details I had selected during booking (like baggage).As a new customer, I wanted a hassle-free experience, so I was disappointed that the confirmation didn’t match what I had seen during the booking process. Fortunately, I had taken a screenshot of the final page, which clearly showed the baggage option I had selected.Now, I’m left having to contact customer care to sort out the baggage issue, which I had already paid for. I hope this gets resolved smoothly, but I really don’t want to be charged extra for baggage that was already included in my original booking. If this happens, I will be posting the screenshots for transparency.I’ll keep you posted on how it get's resolved.*** Update as of 23rd Dec 2024 ***I contacted customer service on Saturday, December 21st, 2024, and they successfully resolved the issue. The staff were friendly and understanding, and they sent an updated booking confirmation email with the correct baggage details. They still need to investigate the discrepancy between what customers see when making a booking online and what is included in the booking confirmation. Otherwise, everything was satisfactory.

title: Smart Booking...faff
review: Overall the booking experience was reasonable. It was bit more involved than I'd expected, didn't realise that my flights had to be through Smart Booking. Which meant I had to wait for a virtual payment card to be sent by OnTheBeach, then required me to go and find the flights myself that matched my booking and book and pay for them using this virtual card. There is a really small time window for you to book the flights or OnTheBeach step in and charge you an admin fee (£48?). Paying with the virtual card wasn't as easy as they made out either as the EasyJet app didn't have Google wallet as a payment option so had to work out how to get the actual card details...tbh it was a bit of a faff and was just relieved I knew how to find out the details, as can't imagine everyone would. Once you've booked your own flights, you've then to update them with your flight number, thankfully email communications were good so it was easy to do...as long as you kept your eye on the emails. The bonus of free lounge passes was much simpler to do, a bit frustrating though as you have to 'opt-in' rather than it being automatic...but understandable as maybe not everyone would want the lounge access. Again plenty of instructional emails to make sure you opted in, if interested.

title: Hotel misrepresented
review: We booked a Thomas Cook 3-night package holiday to Marrakech. The flights (Jet2) were good. I did look at Trip Advisor first, to make sure the hotel would be okay. The staff at the hotel were absolutely lovely. They were friendly, knowledgeable and generally helpful. We booked half board and the dinners - traditional tagine meals - were very good. The hotel is very basic, which I was happy with. The beds were comfortable, and the room and bathroom clean (and cleaned daily). The hotel is also in a great location. We were only there for a city break and could walk to the Medina and to the Jardin Majorelle. The reason for my 3 stars is that I'm not sure where Thomas Cook sourced their photos... Our room certainly didn't look anything like the photos taken. No lovely Moroccan touches like intricate headboards or four poster canopies, just a very, very basic room. The hotel had a slightly run down feeling: the glass in the window of our room had a crack in it, one of the mirrors on the stairs was cracked. The shower was rather weak and there were bits and pieces of old equipment lying around (e.g., a disused coffee machine). Much of the place felt a little unloved. I'd like to repeat that the staff were great and the rooms were clean, so this review is not a reflection on the people.

title: Misdirected bookings, impossible to contact them, even within their hours!
review: Just excitedly completed my holiday booking, and was redirected (unenthusiastically) to Ryanair website to confirm the flights with them separate from my booking. I now realised that in the course of the booking, despite specifically asking for flights from Southend, they offered me a different flight on a different day from Stansted. I have of course now already paid. So I went to the WhatsApp chat, the automated system there refused to talk to me and redirected me to the chat page, which suggested I launch an online chat, which also refused to talk to me. I did originally try to call them (within their expressed hours of opening), but the telephone system redirected me to the website to chat. So basically every contact solution they have redirects you to another one and refuses to have anything to do with you. Genius. A masterclass in how to turn around an excited customer into one that now wants nothing to do with you or your holiday….?!I suspect they will now tell me there is no flight that day from Southend; so our work leave bookings, cat sitter, and more are all going to be completely (shall we politely say) “messed” up?!Addendum - within a day or two I was able to get this all cancelled. To be fair, I may also have misunderstood the opening hours for all forms of contact. I stand by my comments on the original issue though - it’s as bad as Amazon! You search for something and specify ‘from Southend airport’, then why do they show you a load of results including other airports?! Anyway, I am going ahead with the booking again now and being very careful to check the final agreement before I pay this time! Added a star back for their attention to my issue since original review.

title: A beautiful location…
review: The Maxorata hotel is in a beautiful location; a beach view from the sun bathing decks.The food, albeit fresh is quite repetitive with its ingredients. We are all inclusive but astounded that the only bottled water available is in a vending machine. I had to pay a €10 deposit for a kettle and buy our own tea, coffee, sugar, milk and biscuits from a nearby supermarket.We had iced drinks and vending machine free water on our first day but have suffered badly with stomach pain and quite severe kidney pain. No idea why. There is a hotel Dr here but are taking our own paracetamol and ibuprofen with as much water as we can drink.Room cleanliness is good and well attended but there are no draws for underwear etc, just a hanging rail and a shelf.We've spent quite a lot of time in our room due to illness but the English speaking programmes are dubbed with Spanish or German and they're unable to change it back to English so we're limited to news items or kids cartoons and one other chanel.Appreciatively, no-one can do anything about the stormy weather but it is chilly. I'll ask at reception for extra pillows and a blanket for us.Evening entertainment was good; motown music might this evening which I hope will be fun...

title: Daylight Robbery
review: You upped the price of the holiday by £1600 after putting in my card details and pressing book which should be illegal and felt like robbery. The price advertised should be the one paid and how you suddenly add £1600 to the price 10 minutes after starting the booking process is frankly a joke. We paid extra to book seats on the plane which wasn’t possible at check in and yet Thomas Cook won’t refund me for a service I did not receive. I think we can all agree if you paid for a meal in a restaurant and the chef turned round and said he had no food you would expect a refund but for some reason this doesn’t apply to Thomas Cook. It must be lovely to get paid for services you haven’t supplied. When you try and speak to a customer services assistant it isn’t actually possible to speak to a human unless you are booking a new holiday and they are taking your money. If you have an issue that needs sorting it isn’t possible to have an actual conversation you have to talk via what’s app which is incredibly frustrating and terrible customer service. We arrived at the hotel (which is fantastic) only to be told only one room had been booked. My booking confirmation clearly said two but the hotel said only one was showing on the system. $250 dollars to pay for an extra room for the night whilst the fiasco was sorted out the following day wasn’t the best start to the holiday. The only reason this review is two stars and not one is that the on holiday resolution centre is fairly good and the hotel is lovely (not that that has anything to do with Thomas Cook). I imagine if the hotel was run by Thomas Cook you would turn up and despite booking one room would be shoved in some corner of the resort, you wouldn’t get any of the services you paid for and you certainly wouldn’t get a refund!!!

Within minutes of arrival another text - please rate the cleanliness of the apartment. So frustrating to be replying to an automated service. We had a maintenance issue on our first morning so I had to call Pass the Keys which was supposed to have a 24/7 response. The phone rang then had an auto answer with American accent asking to hold. After being told ‘we are searching for an operator’ several times I eventually got asked to leave a message (your call is important to us …). I got a call back 2 hours later, again an American accent, and I explained the problem. ‘Would you want this fixed during your stay?’!! The owner arrived an hour or so later expecting us to be out (miscommunication from Pass the Keys). Repair carried out. We’ve rented apartments via management companies previously that have been less ‘corporate’ and more accessible.

This may be routine for certain countries but coming from South Africa this is not a familiar process at all. Standing in the rain trying to figure this out, after an international flight, was not fun.The 'white key fob' indicating the keys to the basement parking area where in the flat. but without any keys attached. Luckily I did not have a car.it would be great to simplify directions for guests arriving by tube / train. "exit station to your right", this is 'such and such' road. Instead of saying 'head in direction of High Street and left at whatever street. 9 out of 10 visitors have never been to Wapping and would not know where the High St or the Wapping Wall St was if you slapped them with it. My experience of dragging suitcase behind me, in rain, trying to get Google Maps to locate me was quite frustrating. My AirBnB was great, the collecting of keys and trying to understand the directions and instructions was not.

title: Blue chip holidays issue resolved
review: We, like countless others had our bluechip holiday deferred till June 2021. Due to ill health I have tried in vain to contact their customer care team to cancel our holiday either by numerous emails and letter to head office, none of which have been answered, however today I received a phone call from the Head office and offered apologies for no replies to this correspondence. I have come to an amicable agreement with them to cancel our holiday, which has been confirmed. I spoke to Jake and he has sorted out our issues and explained that they are experiencing unprecedented demand from customers due to pandemic but they are trading as normal and suggested that customers use their Hoseasons or Cottages.com support line and telephone number to get through to customer care. I did suggest that an information on the Blue chip website regarding lack of support would be very useful. I would appear that their parent company Vacation rentals was taken over by Awaze Rentals which includes hoseasons and cottages.com and blue chip holidays and due the pandemic working and home working that their usual attention to customers has suffered. Hopefully this will be sorted out in the future. Hope this gives others reading this a little more understanding and a way to contact them in the future.

title: Horizon Villa Mortehoe September 2019
review: Horizon Villa, Mortehoe near Woolacombe....My Sister-In-Law booked this villa for my Father-In-Laws 70th birthday. We arrived to a large house which basically has been split into 4 holiday houses. Horizon Villa is a large 4 bed property with good sized bedrooms and a large open planned kitchen-diner with a lounge. There is also a TV room if the weather is that bad, you can’t get out!! The Villa was presented in a clean condition for our 4 night stay. The downsides unfortunately were that the pots and pans had seen their best days and the sofa was very grubby indeed!! The dining table and chairs were basically cheap rubbish with some of the chairs broken!! Carpets were fraying and badly torn!! The boiler downstairs was inoperative, so there was no hot water downstairs to wash up and clean!! The kettle sure took a hammering......Apparently the guests before us had complained about this, so to be honest at over a £1000 for 4 nights this is pretty poor show!! The main upside though to this villa is it’s location and the views are simply absolutely stunning indeed....

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Our holiday cottage was cancelled but we got a full refund.
review: We booked our UK holiday cottage in January before Covid-19 struck. We were assured that the final payment would not be taken until such time as the government had eased lock-down restrictions and allowed holidays to be taken.Sure enough. once we had the all clear the balance was taken. We contacted the owner to ask a few questions and she told us that she had informed Blue Chip in May that they were cancelling all bookings for 2020/21.I immediately rang Blue Chip and, after being on hold for over an hour, managed to get through to a customer service operative, Molly. I explained the situation and asked her to expedite the refund asap so we could find somewhere else. There was no question of vouchers or moving the booking to a different date, I just wanted a refund.I received a 'phone call 2 days later that the refund had been authorised and would be in my a/c  within 2/3 days which it was.I am disappointed that the property manager had not updated the system when he received the cancellation but am happy that Molly was able to sort out our refund.

We found dead flies/spiders and other insects in window sills and numerous cobwebs that have been there a while.  These were easily wiped up.   Also some of the cupboards and drawers in the kitchen were found to be dirty.- The blinds were very dusty in some of the rooms.- An outside parasol would be of benefit in this very hot weather- There is no mirror in the main bedroom of any description and is really needed- There are no bins in the bathrooms or bedrooms, which again are needed- The dinner plates don't fit in the dishwasher, which was a shame.- We left the dustbin out on Monday evening as instructed, together with the bottle box.  The bin men only took the bottles.  It appeared that all the other properties in the road used boxes.  The correct way of disposing of rubbish needs to be investigated and correct instructions left for renters.

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Previous excellent experiences not replicated this time
review: We have used Blue Chip Holidays on four occasions - in Newquay, Hassocks, Slapton Sands and Westward Ho!Up until now, we have rated Blue Chip as excellent, as the first three accommodations and locations were almost perfect.However, although our most recent accommodation, Sand Dunes, in Westward Ho!  couldn't really be faulted, there were one or two issues about which we were dissatisfied.The apartment was spacious, clean and well furnished with good views from the upper floor across to the sea (though slightly spoilt by the presence of the plastic roof covering the floor below, which wasn't that noticeable in the photo).   In the the sitting room, the larger of the two patio doors was extremely difficult to open.  The smaller patio door was inside partly obstructed by the dining table and outside by a metal strut coming down from the roof and less safe and convenient to use.  The problem was reported but the parts (rollers) required to repair the large patio door had to be ordered and presumably had not arrived before we left, although we received no update.  We were surprised that these sorts of issues were not checked as a matter of routine before guests arrived.The seating area, dining room and kitchen on the upper floor were very well appointed, with a good range of equipment and kitchen items. The bedrooms on the lower floor were similarly well furnished and equipped..We liked Westward Ho! but felt that the description of the beach and the name of the apartment "Sand Dunes" was rather misleading in that there are no sand dunes or soft, dry sand on the beach near the apartment. Also, it is necessary to walk a little way down the "promenade" and down some steps and then negotiate an area of round pebbles and rough rocks in order to access the flat, wet sand.Although we had booked the accommodation partly because it was dog-friendly, in the event we did not take our dog. Had we done so, the nearest beach area did not allow dogs (even though a feature of our accommodation and adjacent holiday chalets was that it/they were "dog friendly").Northam Burrows, where there is a surfing school, is a nice area with a good Visitor Centre and informative staff.  Dogs are allowed in this area but it is some distance from the accommodation to the entrance to Northam Burrows and onward to the beach/surfing area.   Car parking is £4 for the day.Having stayed at Sand Dunes, we feel that the apartment was not particularly suitable for younger children since they only had access to the balcony. We did not realise it would be an issue because we thought that the beach could be directly and easily accessed from the apartment block.We came to the conclusion that the apartment would be more suitable for a group of 6 adults who could use it as a base for surfing, walking the coastal path or cycling/driving to surrounding areas of interest. It may also not be suitable for elderly people because of the lack of easy access to the beach and because of the restriction re dogs within the area in which the apartment is situated.Despite the fact that the accommodation could be occupied by six adults, there is only one allocated car parking space.  Additionally, a couple of weeks before we were due to go on holiday,  we received an e-mail from Blue Chip warning us that the parking arrangments had changed and holidaymakers would have to display a parking permit in the apartment block's ground floor car park.  On arrival at the accommodation, we found an A4 size laminated sheet containing instructions and a parking permit.  For the first three days of our stay, we complied with these instructions but on the fourth day we and our young grandchildren got soaked in a sudden downpour.  We rushed back to the apartment and forgot to place the laminated sheet back on the dashboard.  On going to the car the next day, we found a Parking Penalty Notice.  On our return from holiday I wrote to the car parking company (with a copy to Blue Chip) explaining the circumstances and pointing out that: a code was needed to enter the car park, and our car had been parked in the allocated space for the previous three days so I was surprised that the parking company had no record of our registration number as bona fide occupants of the block.  The company refused to waive the charge of £60 (or £100 if unsuccessfully taken to mediation), despite the fact that we had the right to park in the allocated space (and free parking was a condition of our holiday contract) ,and had merely forgotten on one occasion to display the parking permit.  Had I known when I initially booked the holiday that different, more rigid, parking restrictions would be introduced, I probably wouldn't have booked this particular accommodation..

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Lovely but not perfect.
review: Although we had a lovely holiday at Strawberry Fields I consider the cost of the holiday was not reflected in the quality of our stay.  Firstly having to chase Blue Chip to get confirmation of a change to our booking was unacceptable. Also although Mulberry Lodge is beautifully presented and well equipt there was a short list of faults some of which remained outstanding throughout our stay. Fridge door has fallen slightly causing loud squeaking noise everytime it was opened.  Shower head was faulty.  Large pile of garden cuttings left of the decking.  Blind pulleys in the lounge came apart everytime the blinds were opened or closed.  No clothes horse available.  When you open the dishwasher the whole unit moves forward.  Smoke alarm goes off everytime you cook anything even toast.  You suggest that this a quiet site but perhaps you therefore request that parents keep control of their children.  On several occasions we nearly ran over children who were allowed to run around unsupervised and children screaming and shouting around the site very early in the morning and late at night does not provide for a relaxing holiday.  Also activities at the Memorial Hall that go on all night and into early morning with shouting, swearing and fighting did not help - I am well aware that you could not be expected to control this.Please also review your description of the lodges as thing have changed and you have not corrected them eg comfortable seating on the decking inc table with wine bucket has been replaced with uncomfortable metal bistro furniture.I believe we were unlucky during our stay / booking process but it did make what should have been an outstanding holiday into an average one.

review: Stayed at 6 the vista for 2 weeks not at all impressed with only being supplied with 1 bath towel and 1 face towel each for the week.When requesting extra towels through the property manager was told a £20 charge would be levied for laundry . On phoning Blue Chip to ask if this was correct their agent got argumentative and backed up the property manager on the matter so issue wasn’t resolved satisfactorily.Ok there was a washing machine but having holidayed with Blue Chip on numerous occasions over the last 10 years I was disappointed this time with the response to a simple request. Add to that an ironing board that would not stay up without collapsing and an iron that did not heat up ( replacement given with wires pulling out of plug and not PAT tested ) and the Worcester system boiler was missing one of the anyiliser test point sealing plugs on the flue elbow,glaringly obvious and a safety issue ( have photos Blue Chip) you tend to feel annoyed given the price paid for our stay.

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Sea Winds Torquay
review: + The house is spacious & in a beautiful and peaceful setting. + Plenty of parking space on the drive.+ The garden is steep but vast and secure for the dog to roam at his leisure. + Friendly gardeners arrived on Friday to mow the lawns. + Comfortable beds and great shower in the upstairs bathroom.+ Provisions for cream teas left for our arrival was a welcome touch.+ On arrival, we were told that a bedroom blind had fallen down but had been reported to the handyman. He arrived within the hour and made the repairs. The landing blind fell down during our stay and was reported to the Manager on the Tuesday. No repair was actioned during our stay. - The security spotlights to the rear of the house needed new bulbs (reported to the Manager on the Tues of our stay but no action taken.) Luckily we had taken a head torch to access the garden with dog after dark.- The steps idown to the lawned area of the garden were hard to distinguish - they would benefit from white paint to mark the edge of each step. - There were no mattress or pillow protectors on the beds.- There were no bins in the upstairs bathroom or any of the bedrooms.- Disappointing lack of storage in the master bedroom and twin bedroom - luckily the landing is spacious and we were able to keep suitcases with clothes in out there.- The information folder in the house would benefit from added detail eg, where to find the recycling bins and wheelie bin and the collection dates for these. The wheelie bin was already full when we arrived and was not due for collection during the week of our stay.- Rotary washing line had seen better days - it was positioned too near the the hedge to rotate and needed loose parts repositioning for each use.- Plastic plant pots (containing dead plants) were weathered and snapped leaving sharp elements exposed. -The garden furniture would benefit from the addition of a parasol for some shade. There is a motorised awning which provides shade to a small area of the patio but mainly shades the sun room of the house. Overall, we enjoyed our stay. We feel that addressing these minor points would make all the difference to this house and would certainly make us re-book in the future.

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Kingsley House Newquay - not open to complains!
review: In fairness to Blue Chip Holidays, which we have used many times, every time to our satisfaction, despite some delay they did respond and have offered some compensation. Our gripe is with the property owners, whose responses to each of the complaints was waffle at the very least! The door excuse, well leave that to you, we have photos of other complaints. We were never after compensation, just to hope for improvement (which will not happen as they do not accept feedback) and to let other potential users have some warning. Advice is, any problem, report it immediately!Thank you for your patience in allowing me to investigate your feedback regarding your stay at Kingsley House.The owners of the property were extremely sorry to hear about your complaint,  and have responded accordingly.In regards to the front door the owner has stated:The front door had been locked by the cleaners and sometimes the door does like to get a little difficult to lock, the cleaners did make sure it was locked on the date of your arrival.The paracetamol on the floor, the caretakers have said:All floors in the property are hoovered and beds do get checked underneath also, The owner has said the beds were not pulled from the wall so there is a chance something was hidden and missed.Dog Chew/hair in the property:The property did have a guest with a dog in the week before. and the hoover they have is really effective in removing dog hair, he has said it is sometimes impossible to remove all traces. there was also no sign of a dog toy by the cleaners.The pots and pans the cleaners have advised:The cleaners have mentioned that a few baking trays could need replacing, All pots and pans were cleaned in the dishwasher and put away in the cupboards.We do advise guests that if any problems were to arise at the property during your stay,  to call your local contact,  so they can call and address any issues raised. We also have advisors on hand 7 days a week, 9am - 8pm -  Mon - Sat and 10am - 6pm on Sunday who will be happy to offer assistance throughout your stay.

title: 1 Quay Court in Newquay - Aug 2020
review: We stayed at 1 Quay Court in Newquay last week. The house in itself was impressive with beautiful views across the coast. However we were very disappointed with the cleanliness of the house, particularly in the current climate.We were told we couldn't access the house until 5pm on the Saturday due to the house requiring a deep (Covid) clean and airing. Although inconvenient having driven 6 hours we felt this reasonable. However there was absolutely no sign of a deep clean or airing when we finally got in. I've compiled a list of problems;Dust everywhere - on lamps, under furniture, on top of bed headboards etcGrease on kitchen extractor fanWindows filthy inside and out in the lounge areaBalcony glass covered in bird poo which was clearly oldRoof terrace unusable due to dirt, moss and general conditionUsed plaster down side of settee1 toilet roll per bathroom for the weekNo handsoap provided in bathroomsNo cleaning products provided such as washing up liquid, kitchen spray etcNo beach towels nor equipment provided even though we were told towels were includedCrockery needed washing before useSettee was stainedLightbulbs dead in 3 of the bedside lampsNo welcome pack provided.For the money we paid for the week (£2,350!) we expected a lot more and especially for the house to at least feel and look clean. We feel the cleaning company has let the owners down as the house has nice furniture but it all felt tired, unloved and a bit depressing. We definitely won't be returning.

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Nail-biting time getting our security deposit back.
review: I have used Bluechip in the past with great success but this holiday hasn't turned out well.  Mainly because they've taken my £400 security deposit and haven't given it back nearly a month after our return!  No one answers the phone. You can call once at 8.59am and get the 'offices are closed' message and then again at 9am on the dot and be on hold for an hour before giving up.  My emails haven't been returned either.  I have started a dispute through my bank.  Previous communications have always come from Bluechip, but the experience before the holiday was odd with emails coming from Hoseasons, Cottages.com and Bluechip.  We also stayed in 1 Quay Court, Newquay.  I'm laughing with the irony of the previous lady's post about cleanliness because we were the first in when lockdown restrictions were lifted and the house smelled, there was no hand wash, sanitiser, not enough toilet roll to last a full day, the BBQ was mouldy and the sofa is broken as well as stained.  So the same situation as the other review BUT the cleaners were stood outside at 9.15am on the last day kicking us out early because they had 'extra cleaning' to do because of COVID!  I ended up leaving my expensive chef's knife behind because of the pressure and it still being in the dishwasher that I was waiting to finish.  No hope of getting that back, either, because they've all disappeared.Edit: I did get the deposit back eventually.  Thought it would be fair to update my review to be more positive, but it has negatively affected my perception of what used to be a go-to company for me.  I'm associating that with what appears to be the takeover by Cottages.com

description: Leading provider of 4 & 5 star luxury holiday cottages, apartments and lodges, with over 1,000 stunning properties across Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, the Isle of Wight and Yorkshire.
title: Book direct and save £200!
review: We had a number of issues with Blue Chip. Firstly, we had to cancel our long-standing, original booking (Isle of Wight) a few weeks before departure after we were informed that major building work would be taking part in the apartment block. In Blue Chip's defence, they then provided us with a few alternatives and we accepted one.We didn't get a confirmation email, so we telephoned the owners of the property and eventually had our booking confirmed by them and subsequently by Blue Chip after we contacted them again.Blue Chip charged us nearly £200 more than we would have paid if we'd booked direct with the vendors. We queried this disparity with two members of Blue Chip staff (email and phone). Both declined to respond.Before the holiday, Blue Chip took £150 from our bank account, despite there being no requirement for a deposit on the re-booking.In summary, if you can, book direct with the vendor and save yourself a rip-off additional charge of £200 by Blue Chip.COMMENT ON BLUE CHIP'S RESPONSE:Blue Chip may not be able to control how property owners offer their properties and for how much, but... they can control how much additional cost they pile onto their unfortunate customers. £200 (circa +25%) is clearly extortionate and unjustifiable. We presume that Blue Chip have an arrangement with vendors (in this case with a large portfolio of properties) to provide the same property at a comparative price - if not, why not? If Blue Chip are seriously concerned about customer service, answer this simple question - Why did you charge us £200 more?
