title: Do Not Use HolidaysPlease on a Fly Drive USA Holiday
review: We have recently returned from a Deep South USA Fly drive holiday booked through Holidays Please, and are not impressed and would never use them again, our point of contact was a Sarah Craig Walker who was very polite, but in hindsight clearly lacked experience in this type of holiday. The basic brief was to fly to Atlanta, pick up a SUV hire car, stay one night  and then drive to Nashville, Memphis and New Orleans with good quality hotels in centre of the cities. We were not asking for best price deals.Firstly she  failed to inform us of valet parking charges at various hotels she had recommended on the itinerary, but did advise us to be fair not to park in New Orleans.The Hotel in Atlanta was fine, the Hotel in Nashville was The Best Western Plus, which was in fact a Motel no facilities no bar, no lounge, extremely basic buffet breakfast, Building falling apart, being refurbished in common areas out of necessity, Air conditioning units in rooms going back 30 years really noisy, nowhere near Downtown Nashville 20/25 min walk for youngsters, had to get a taxi there and back each time.The Hotel in Memphis was the Sheraton Memphis Downtown which was fine, but only accessible to downtown by a tram service which is great if you are in Memphis from end of April to end of October. Apart from housekeeping not cleaning rooms at all on the floor we were on, including ours on two occasions, and apparently a four star hotel not having back up housekeeping in emergencies it was OK.The Hotel in New Orleans Position wise was good, although  we had ask for a double bedded room which we found out, had not been ask for by Sarah, so we ended up in a twin single room. Document states “Standard Room”Finally it was all booked it seems through a company called Funway, which only comes to light on the very final paperwork. HolidaysPlease are clearly working on the best commission deals to them, and not always what is best for their clients, and clearly lack much experience in this type of Holiday, certainly compared to companies like Trailfinders.Bob Peel & Janet Tankel

title: Misled and disappointed!
review: Booking Ref 8800781 29th July - 12th August 2017.  When booking this holiday, Neisha was so helpful, putting together my package, offering a professional personal service and  promoting HolIdays Please as the top rated on line travel agency.  Unfortunately the reality was from it.  1.  Neisha informed me I could book my flight seats with Norwegian Airlines and gave me a reference number to do so.  The airline did not give the option, therefore our family of 4, 2 adults and 2 children were seated apart 2 and 2 on the outward and return journey.  2.  Having booked half board, on our first evening we arrived at 9.30pm (Dinner was between 7.30pm and 10pm).  There were few people eating and plenty of tables, but none set up.  We  helped ourselves to the buffet, but unable to find any cutlery requested some.  My husband ordered drinks from the waiter, but these didn't arrive and we thought we had been forgotten.  As we finished, the very perplexed waiter arrived with our drinks, apologised for the delay, as he was working in the bar and was obviously run off his feet.  We thanked him, drunk our drinks and left.  3.  The following morning we went for breakfast just after 9.30am, (breakfast was between 7.30am and 10.30am).  It was very busy and after looking around there were no tables available.  Seeing the restaurant manager I asked if she could find us a table.  She shook her head and gestured with her hands, saying "it's always like this."  After the previous evening's experience, which I'd hoped was a one off, I complained to the hotel manager and asked for the half board refund.  The manager was happy to do this, until she looked at the booking.  She said we booked through "booking.com" I said Holidays Please!  I was unable to get a refund as my booking was through a 3rd party and they needed to ok it.  I contacted Neisha and asked for a refund, but she informed me it was highly unlikely I would get a refund and suggested going for breakfast earlier.  I suggested the hotel needs to employ more staff or limit their numbers.  The staff were kind and helpful - but soooo stretched.   Neisha contacted the hotel but hadn't had a response.   I did not get a refund, but ate out at extra cost to me.  4.   Having arrived on the Saturday, on Sunday we returned from our day out to find there was no room service and no clean towels.  I thought I saw a notice somewhere saying the maids day off is a Sunday, so accepted this.  On Monday  we returned to find the same.  I phoned reception to be told the room is only serviced twice weekly as are towels changed.  I contacted Neisha and asked what exactly I had paid for - I didn't get an answer to my question.  I contacted reception again and was told my room should be cleaned and towels changed daily.  The receptionist kindly sent a maid to do so.   The hotel staff and management could not have been more helpful.  Unfortunately the problem lies with Holidays Please who offer this bespoke service and ask for a review as soon as the booking is confirmed. Holidays Please goes under many names but Hays Travel is the umbrella.  Basically, as Neisha informed me when i complained about room service, it's a 'hotel room' I booked. No frills and no responsibility, it was down to me to sort it with the management - which I did! That wasn't the approach when I booked, I was even told my tickets would be sent in a leather wallet.  I didn't want a leather wallet, I wanted value for money and a good service, not spending the first three days sorting out the above isssues.   As for the wallet, it's as false as the companies promises.  I will be making a complaint - not against the hotel it's fine and the staff are great! Not so Holidays Please.  II

She said chef wants you to enjoy it, that was was difficult as he was already full, but it was an improvement. We ordered a dessert to share which was a disappointment and most of it was left.For breakfast my husband had the full English which came out lukewarm. He could not be bothered to send it back as that would have been a wait for another. The yogurt with granola and berries was very good.When we checked out, there was a power cut due to the storm, so we were unable to settle the bill. When we spoke to them on the phone, they wanted more payment than we owed, wanted to charge us for the meal which was included with the travelzoo voucher, then kept readjusting the payment due when we queried it as there only drinks to pay for, it seemed dishonest, and I would not return.

title: Disappointing
review: I have been a travelzoo member for many years and have just paid for another years membership. I am very disappointed with this most recent trip, hence my honest feedback. The staff and food were lovely with the following exception. When ordering our dinner I asked if it was possible to have skin on fries rather than chunky chips and stated I would pay extra. Waiter said he would check with kitchen. Next conversation I had was when meal was served with chunky chips. I reminded him of our earlier conversation and was told that what I had been served (ie chunky chips) was the same as skin on fries. I tried to argue the point but he wouldn't back down but did remove the price of 1 beer from the overall bill.  I remain confused as the menu clearly stated that steaks were served with skin on fries so it seems there would have been availability from the kitchen.  The room was very clean although extremely tired and the double bed appeared to be a small double bed, ie. 4ft wide. Hotel policy didn't appear to accommodate changes, I.e. on booking the break I asked if we could have an alternative to prosecco. Answer was negative. Its a shame as I am normally generous with my star ratings but feel these few little glitches let the hotel down. Also am not certain of official star rating but would think a low to mid 3 star rating would be the best one could expect.

title: I'm so glad to have visited your branch…
review: I'm so glad to have visited your branch in the city and to speak to someone face to face better than I did it on line. The person that  help me through my holiday booking was so helpful and provided me all the information that I have asked for.

title: Successful flight booking.
review: Flight centre responded to my initial enquiry in a timely manner, there were some adjustments needed to accommodate our requests but we got there in the end.

title: Replies were prompt and when asked to…

We just wonder did Becky have all the information to hand? Not a problem, we would rather have questions asked to be absolutely sure of our requirements. All in all a pleasant experience. Many thanks.

title: Jamie at Flight Centre
review: Jamie! Where do I begin, talk about going beyond the pale.  Flight center closes at 6pm but it was 10.59pm last night and Jamie was still in contact with me to sort out my holiday, 6 week trip to South America in November.literally 3 weeks away and I hadn't done anything, didnt even know the capital of Brazil(Brasilia).  We were trying to avoid paying asap, not that it was cheap by any means but if we booked in November the prices would sky rocket again  Miraculously within a few days we sorted out travel to cities in Brazil, Columbia, Peru, Ecuador, Chile and Argentina, everything was organised(reorganised a few times?!) and booked.  Everything included airport transfers, hotels, flights and tours.If anything I learned is book with Jamie well in advance, like months in advance to save all the stress.  What normally takes proper planning and tour reviews he compacted into days.  Would have saved all the reworking Jamie and I had to go through over and over.  And yet he stuck with it and got it all done.We're planning a trip to New Zealand next year as well, but lets just take a breath and relax for a second before taking on a second round.

title: Eliza Joiner could not have been more…
review: Eliza Joiner could not have been more helpful. I am happy that all was smooth and look forward to seeking the help of you at Flight Centre for my future travel arrangements. There’s nothing like personal service offered by your experts. Thank you.

title: Great service by Ronnette G
review: Great service by Ronnette G - trip planning, communication and queries handled smoothly and promptly.

title: Mega-trip to Canada
review: Have used Flight Centre (before Covid) and decided to use them again for our last mega-trip.Attentive, quick to reply and a smooth 'transfer' to another Agent whilst ours was on holiday.  All trips/hotels/transfers booked except those not operating 'til 2024. Very good service.

title: If you're looking for a responsible…
review: If you're looking for a responsible tour guide in the UK, FLIGHT CENTRE is your call, just the same way that if you're searching for responsible broker manager in UK, House Mining Investment UK is there for you. You only need to search!

title: Brighton
review: I saw Ryan at the Western Road Branch in Brighton- he quickly grasped my requirements and situation and then dealt with me in a courteous &professional manner. I have always been happy to use Flight Centre .

title: N Z and Oz again
review: Revisiting Flight Centre who we have used for trips before. This time flights and car hire only as we are visiting friends and family. We are well travelled so have a good idea of what we need. Liz took that on board and was able to sort our requirements quickly and efficiently. She responded quickly and helpfully to our requests and queries. Final booking and payment system is easy to use. Overall a good experience and no doubt we shall use Flight Centre again.

title: Round the World booking
review: Our contact, Harry, was very good. Worked out a schedule promptly and found a much cheaper option using an alternative route that didn't significantly affect our plans. Kept in touch regularly and quickly updated plans as and when needed. All information supplied was comprehensive and clear.The reason I've given 4 stars is that on requesting a train journey to be included which we had already priced, we found that the quote was for 50% above the cost price. we went on to book that element privately and have not booked hotels with Flightcentre as a result.

title: Would have liked a pre trip essentials folder
review: Always got a fast response when putting together the trip itinerary.I felt the only lacking element was the pre trip information. Everything is online for you to find but no pre travel paperwork  is sent out any longer. It was a complex 5 week trip and at least emergency contact numbers if problems out of uk hours etc would have been helpful in a small travel folder. It turned out a flight was cancelled and I found it difficult to find any number for Flight Centre. Searching around internet with poor connectivity is the last thing you need when in this situation.

title: Specialist advice
review: Our consultant helped us book a complex itinerary, and gave good advice about flight options and destinations. He was able to find flights and prices that we could not have found if we'd tried to book online ourselves. Very competent and personable service.

title: Excellent Service
review: I'm extremely happy with the service I've received so far and in particular Gavin Sutton who I've been dealing with. The knowledge provided is extremely impressive, helpful and reassuring. Any query that I've had has been answered promptly and in great detail. I'm happy that I've chosen this service and would recommend other people to use.

title: Attentive & Helpful staff. They listened to our requirements they…
review: They listened to our requirements they listened to our preferences they offered best deals going at the time. All in all satisfied with the outcome and offered extra help on helping us with our visas.Would recommend flight centre every time.

title: A four week adventure to…
review: Booked a four week adventure to Singapore and New Zealand through Flight Centre (Sarah Patuck at the Bristol office).  Whole booking process was efficient and smooth. Flights on Singapore Airlines were good, the one flight on Air New Zealand not so good, not in the same class. Car hire in Aukland could have been better, location of office and info not good, but that was more the hire company than Flight Centre.  Holiday not quite what we planned as arrived half a day ahead of a cyclone, but we survived and will dine out on it for years.  In short Flight Centre did a good job.

title: Thus far in my Philippines saga
review: Thus far in my Philippines saga, Charlie Watt has been enormously helpful - within the constraints of your somewhat expensive flight rebooking fee tables - where 252.00 to change my UK return date is a high burden for a poor old pensioner to bear…

title: Very helpful
review: Very helpful, well informed advice especially relevant to helping elderly folks. Polite conduct throughout notably with exploring booking options. Will use again!Only little glitch was missing an earlier flight booking

title: Sam McLean is excellent and always…
review: Sam McLean is excellent and always helpful. The rail agent you use is somewhat erratic and does not always seem to understand my requirements. Overall I am very satisfied with the service I have received and I will continue to use Flight Centre, as long as Sam is with you.

title: I'd like to see how much is spent on…
review: I'd like to see how much is spent on the flight and how much on the hotel and how much in commission

title: Good communication but beware
review: Good communications with my trip planner and he provided some good ideas about what cities to visit in each country when asked. However, beware of some limitations the Flight Centre has. They can only book hotels on their books and they don’t have access to the budget airlines. I paid £480 for two flights which would have cost £180 if I had of booked them myself on a different comparison website. I am totally gutted about this and it’s brought into question what else I am overpaying for.

title: Seemed promising but …
review: Seemed promising but couldn't get past the online submission form to get fares to Auckland. Just kept circling back to the top without saying why. Also I don't want phone calls unless I intend to go forward with the quote so didn't like adding that. Looks like my business will go elsewhere. Shame.

title: The service I was giving on 27/01/2023 by Imogen Altmann was good…
review: The service I was giving on 27/01/2023 was good and I like to continue buying my travel ticket from your company in the future.

title: The person who was taking care of my…
review: The person who was taking care of my ticket went on holidays without notifying about that, or referring to another person who would be in a position to complete my purchase in their absence.This was surprising.Also, it would be helpful that upon search for the flight tickets the options shared with me would be more informative, and include such aspects as the price of the ticket, duration of the overall travel. Id like to have this info at once, without the need to ask.

title: When I went online direct to Emirates…
review: When I went online direct to Emirates website for cost of First class / Business class flights they were considerably cheaper than the quote I got from Flight centre...... I expected that the quote would be the best cost possible? I have spent a lot of money booking regular flights and now have a feeling that I've been cheated!!!

title: Over all relatively satisfied with the…
review: Over all relatively satisfied with the service I have received. Tho think the operators could do with knowing more about Visa's.As when questioned was told we are not trained in that field .At the time had they had the answer it would have gone a long way  but having said that the operator did do their best to be helpful . In the end it all came together

title: Had an absolutely amazing trip but….
review: Had an absolutely amazing trip However, unfortunately towards the end of the trip multiple people in my party caught covid. I had called the emergency line to update them on what was going on and to let them know they wouldn’t make the flight. I was on hold for over 50 minutes with no answer. I was charged over £100 for this. By the sounds of it nobody was at work that day which is unfortunate as I ended up paying for it in my phone bill.

title: I had to keep chasing him with visits and phone calls
review: I had to keep chasing him about the holiday and quote given that he promised to send to me via email but didn’t.i changed to another person and she was great and my holiday booked on the same day .she was helpful and provided with the information I needed

title: I was very happy with the service I…
review: I was very happy with the service I received when buying my flight tickets for South Africa last year. Not so impressed when trying to get my refund due to flights being cancelled due to COVID.The help I have had from Jack Busby has been fab and he is trying his very best to help me but I am not happy with how long it is taking to get the refund.

title: It is annoying,for over ,25years Going…annoying
review: It is annoying,for over ,25years Going into your SHOP in Sutton was PERFECT your staff was brilliant.now it is a lottery getting in touch.your phone service is rubbish.Please re-open Sutton shop you are losing a lot of customer good will

title: Communication bad during lockdown
review: I had a flight in April that obviously didn't happen but thought I might fly Aug. But with lockdown I struggled to get hold of anyone at Flight Centre for 2 months! Several times i hung on for 20 mins to 3/4 hour! Very frustrating. Was so relieved when someone finally answered! But then Matthew was extremely helpful to put in for my refund and organise flights for next year. Hopefully this doesn't happen again with next lockdown!

title: WHERE IS MY REGULAR CONSULTANT
review: The service was average and well below what I am use too The consultant was reasonable but did not have the information I have been use to being in his possessio. Where is my regular consultant Mr Michael McQueen from GlasgowPlease let me talk with him or at least have records of our requirements filed in order to prevent lots on endless talks

title: Overall a good service
review: Overall a good service, booking business class flights to Florida as a special treat.One point I was very unhappy with - mis-information at the cost of pre-booking seat numbers - quoted £50pp each way - when allocating seats on Airline website found these to be £100 plus pp each way. I feel as though I have been conned ! - because you can only get to this stage by paying for flights in full.

title: I'm just requesting for a hard copy of…
review: I'm just requesting for a hard copy of my flight which Jo Gilmour is always doing this for me. I am a regular client ofFlight Centre for a long-time. This is the first time my request was being refused. I just feel upset about this.

title: satisfactory
review: The reason i was slightly disappointed was all due to the cost of the ticket.  I have used The flight Centre for many years and they have always priced matched to the same price the airline was quoting, but on this occasion i was told no price match.  This is why i only gave a rating of satisfactory, but slightly disappointed  -  updated review after response from flight centre

title: Mostly happy
review: Was very happy with the service from Flight Centre. Gemma was so friendly and accommodating and got me exactly what I asked for. I will certainly book with her again. I was however annoyed that the flight that was put on hold for me, the next day after less than 24 hours, had gone off hold and I had to pay an extra £50. This has never happened to me before when I have booked with Flight Centre or anyone else.

title: Recently booked my flight to Australia…
review: Recently booked my flight to Australia with Darrel Pearce Oxford St, received my E Ticket and Receipt same day. Tried to pre-book my seats on- line, only to be told my Tickets are not issued. After 4 days. E-mailed Darrel to find out the reason, reply was he was on holiday until 29th October and to contact his colleagues or he would contact me on his return. Spoke to Leah Fraser who did it there and then, thanks to her.

title: Kept making promises and not following…
review: Kept making promises and not following threw i.e find me local activities and send them to me, saying they check me in and then saying I need to do it, when I had issues booking activities I was told go speak to hotel even though they said they would sort it at the start. It felt like once I paid for my holiday they didnt want to know

title: Not good at arranging holidays
review: We wanted to go to three countries India, New Zealand and Australia. We needed their help in first two as we had relatives to help us. However we asked them to plan our Australian trip. Alister was point of contact at Flight Centre. I am sorry to say please ask someone else to plan your holiday for as the name suggests they are Flight Centre and only good at arranging flights

title: I have used Flight Centre several times…
review: I have used Flight Centre several times and must have spent upwards of £50,000 on Business Class fares to Sydney , using Emirates .I had always trusted your pricing but on this occasion I was charged £561 more than if I had booked direct with Emirates . I was very disappointed by this so it is unlikely that I will use you next year . The member of your staff was excellent .No complaints there , it is simply your price .

title: Rang and spoke about my holiday…
review: Rang and spoke about my holiday requirements with a lovely person but who then I never heard from again. Called FC back to track down what was going on and couldnt find my order at all and made me feel it was my fault as I didnt know the original agents name! ps when you pick up the phone it might be worth saying "hello how are you?" or "how can I help" or anything rather than just stating your name and leaving a silence. Bizarre.

title: We were told that flight centre could…
review: We were told that flight centre could book our seats and book a baby bassinet. This was a priority for us. Then we paid and secured the flights, only to be told “get to the airport early on day of the flight to make sure you get the bassinet”. So seems they knew we couldn’t book the bassinet but told us they could to get the business, then played dumb and said oh well sorry. Unacceptable.

title: I called today to ask if Flight Centre…
review: I called today to ask if Flight Centre still do price matching (they used to and it was a great service) - the lady who took my call quite aggressively told me they don't and that they are generally more expensive (what a way to sell your company!). They gave a price that was significantly more than online (approx £140-£150) more & said there is no budge room on their pricing. This company has changed for the worse & sadly they are no longer competitive with other companies! Feeling very disappointed with their aggressive communication style & inflexibility with pricing!

title: Booking tickets was fine
review: Booking tickets was fine, but they failed to mention that the airport terminals would close during my lay over so I had to leave the airport in the middle of the night with all my luggage to find somewhere to stay for 5 hours until the terminals reopened the following day. Thankfully no harm occurred, but it certainly placed me in a dangerous position tht I could have avoided had this advice been supplied prior to me travelling.

title: My wife booked a trip with flight…
review: My wife booked a trip with flight centre some months ago to visit our daughter and grandchildren in Australia we were desperate to see them as we had never seen the youngest and all of them since before covid struckShe was told by the agent Phil birdken that we could book premium economy with extra leg room for over 3k per person with number one airline Singapore airlines but biggest problem we had was my eldest daughter is a very nervous flyer and we would need seats together for all legs of the flightWe were told this was not a problem however when we boarded all the flights not one were with seats together we managed to get staff to change thing around with one of us sitting elseware on the planeI also thought Singapore airlines were no better than any other staff average food average toilets very very smallI would not recommend flight centre or Singapore and will not use againNick

So I save up for it and for the £ I've spent on my holiday the detail really matters yet is often missing. I often find myself chasing the small details with Destinology and end up doing some of the research myself. Sometimes it's nice to go and look at the website but when you find other things on there that would turn the luxury dial up and have to suggest it, it's a bit disappointing that they didn't find it, when they knew that's what I wanted. They also never include details of the room in their quotes (which are generally nicely done) and again I have to go searching. Again, at one level that's OK - but at this level I use destinology because I want someone to do that for me.  Once it is sorted, again they are good and will put it in. But what else did I miss? So I finish where I started. I do use them and would say again, they're good - but at the luxury end of the market (where Destinology operate) a bit more attention to detail is needed.

title: A confused back office
review: When booking our holiday the travel advisor was very helpful and friendly and found us the hotel we wanted at the right price. We paid the deposit for the holiday and then had to pay for the flights up front which we know can happen. Later that day we had another phone call requesting the full amount for the holiday in case we changed our mind, we had never heard of this practice before, we are not novice travellers we have travelled all over the world. We questioned this point and said if this was the case we would cancel the booking, the travel advisor had spoken to accounts and if we paid a further sum not the whole amount as requested then that would suffice. One has to understand that this holiday is not until May 2024.  At this point so far so good. We were then awaiting the confirmation which arrived, that evening, which sent my wife into panic mode as the cost of the holiday had trebled and at this time at night we could not reach anyone to explain. An Email was sent to find out what was going on. Next morning we had a reply stating that we should rest assured that the booking was complete, and it was just us amending our supplier in the back office and it would amend its self. As you can imagine we had rather a long night with little sleep and a considerable amount stress and anxiety, and even though the problem was resolved and the fault lay with there system we had no apology just to say rest assured all is ok. We now await the holiday May and trust all will be fine and there are no more problems.

She said most of their clients had no problems, but in any case we could be switched to a later flight as we were on a through booking or words to that effect. However when we reached Johannesburg, South African Airlines said we did not have a through booking and refused to put us on a later flight. title: Booked honeymoon
review: I booked a honeymoon with Destinology a few months ago as they beat a quote i had initially got and no one seemed to be able to beat their price. Having looked at the awards they won and the reviews, I felt secure booking with them.Initially they were great and responded quickly and politely to everything before i booked. I had booked the holiday months in advance so after I was booked, there was no contact for a while. This is where I had an issue. I wasn't hearing anything back so closer to the time I got in touch with destinology asking about my documents and seats etc. The person I was dealing with told me that she had tried to call me a couple of months earlier to ask about our seating requirements but that she couldnt get through. She said she had left a voice message, which is untrue as I didnt have one. What annoyed me is that she didnt try to call again and the fact that she could have e-mailed me. Because I had apparently missed the opportunity to discuss this, I had missed out on a chance to select any good seats left and was left to choose whatever was available. But selecting from those seats were pointless too, as we never got what we wanted on any of the flights. I got past that, and had other queries and noticed other errors on the itinerary. I had kept e-mailing the consultant i was dealing with, but never seemed to get a response. I was often told i'd get a call, but never did. The only time I got any answers was when I had to call up myself. Would have been nice to get replies to the e-mails I had sent. At one point i got fed up and wrote an e-mail of complaint which also seemed a waste as the response I got ignored all I had to say and just asked what my queries were. Also one of my flights had changed to a day later but the only reason I knew about this was because I called her for something else, otherwise I probably wouldnt have even been notified and new itinerary sent! Whilst I feel that the customer service before flying was very poor, I do appreciate the consultant sorting the whole thing out for us. Everything was ok, there was a problem with one of the transfers not turning up to pick us up from the hotel but that was the fault of the pick up company and not destinology. I was reimbursed for it with no problems.  Overall a good experience as everything went ok with the holiday, it was just the customer service beforehand that I was disappointed with. As it was my honeymoon, I wanted everything to go smoothly so would have appreciated quicker responses and more reassurance.

title: Anything but luxurious or exclusive
review: We cut our recent travels to the Far East short following several disappointing experiences organised by Destinology.  Given the lengthy travel time back from Boracay Island, to Manila onto London and the considerable extra expense we incurred, the decision to return early was one we did not take lightly and reflects the poor quality of the locations and accommodation which Destinology booked.  With the exception of the second resort, El Nido, the two other resorts, Oceanica Resort in Bohol and the Crimson Resort in Boracay Island were anything but exclusive or luxurious.  Poor quality of the facilities such as the pool area, the gym, the gardens, the surrounding area and the general look and feel of the place with shoddy build-quality everywhere.  Unfortunately, I am unable to share the pictures I took of the mould on the ceiling, the water pouring in from the rain at the resort restaurants (plural), the mass tourism locations or the dirty floors and pool areas.What made the experience even more disappointing was the ever presence of mass tourism at the resorts, the surrounding areas and during the ‘exclusive’ activities organised by Destinology.  During one ‘private’ snorkelling trip with our family for example we were surrounded by hundreds of loud, inconsiderate tourists who all congregated on a small coral reef with tens of tourist-boats floating about in the same area.  We experienced similar mass events during other outings which we sold to us by Destinology as ‘exclusive’ and ‘luxurious’.  I would not recommend Destinology as a travel company despite the fact that its staff is helpful and friendly.  It seems to me that Destinology lacks local knowledge of the resorts and destinations that it sends its clients to, at some considerably expense, and as a result, it is not able to guarantee the quality that it claims it can deliver.

description: An award-winning luxury tour operator, at Destinology we know how important your precious holiday time is and how overwhelming choosing exactly the right place can be. title: VERY DISAPPOINTING
review: VERY DISAPPOINTINGThe advertising and details of the trip looked good, but it appears to have been written by a marketing person in a remote office somewhere, and nobody checked if what they were promising was actually possible or could be delivered. And it wasn’t. Most timings were wrong, trips had delayed departures just about every day except for the two days when they were cancelled. Every day lots of reasons/excuses given but many difficult to believe.First the PositivesServing staff generally very good but when ordering drinks had long delays in being served up to 20 minutes at times.Food generally good but certainly nothing special, and the wine was ‘£7 a bottle in the supermarket’ level, very average.Now some of the Negatives. I could give you pages of problems but here are just a few examples -Embarkation –Timings were wrong, couldn’t book in for 2 hours Not a great start.Disembarkation was much worse, Chaotic. Our itinerary showed leave the ship at 4pm. But Swan Hellenic said out of your cabin by 8am, off the ship by 9am, later changed to 1pm but with no use of facilities onboard. Fortunately, after a lot of hard work by another guest things got sorted out as best they could in the circumstances.Free wi-fi advertised, even on the rolling advert screen on the ship. Reality was ‘free wi-fi’ was $25 a day and you had to pay for the whole cruise, so for $250 for the trip. Not my idea of free wi-fi.On the sundeck, 6 sunbeds for 160 guests. We were told by the staff they couldn’t put any more out, but up on the top stargazing deck there were dozens of sunbeds, but all packed away in storage racks.Tenders – in the advertising - New feature on SH Diana “onboard tender boats to take guests passengers ashore in addition to, and in greater comfort than, the customary expedition Zodiacs.”Reality was the tenders were never used. They tried twice to launch the tenders, both abandoned so back to using the zodiacs and with the usual delays.Visit to the Botanic gardens on day 2 walk through the start of the gardens. Visit the toilets then back again to the bus so didn’t see the majority of the gardens. Very disappointing.Curieuse day 3 Split into groups for the walk, our leader kept looking down at her phone then we realised she looking at google earth to try to find the way. Then told we had to wait for the next group because ‘their leader had the key to the doctor’s house’ Waited 20 minutes so they could overtake us, but when we arrived at the Doctor’s house it was closed for renovation. Not a very believable excuse.Praslin Valle de Mai day 5 delayed start as usual. When we arrived packed with people, lots of other groups, so very difficult to hear what the guide was saying or stop and look at anything. 20 minutes or so walk along the main access path, then back to the shop at the entrance and out to the bus.Island visit Grand Soeur didn’t happen, cancelledIsland visit Aride didn’t happen, cancelledLa Digue Tour of the island. Advertised as ‘a tour of the island’ followed by a visit to the Union Estate. Reality was we drove from the jetty to the nearby Union Estate. We asked where was the tour of the island? Told by the tour operator and Swan Hellenic it was the drive from the jetty to Union Estate.So a memorable holiday, unfortunately mostly for the wrong reasons.Overpromised and underdelivered.After nearly 2 weeks a reply from Destinology forwarded by the cruise company Swan Hellenic with many of the questions not answered, just ignored.My first cruise and probably my last.

title: I will give Priority Pass 5 stars…
review: I will give Priority Pass 5 stars because I think they do a great job. It wouldn't be fair to rate Priority Pass based on individual lounge experiences. They vary widely and you can rate the lounges individually.Most times and places, with PP you get the same treatment as a business class passenger. Personally speaking, my worst lounge experiences using PP are consistently in UK airports. Their coverage is also weak in major hubs like Frankfurt, Paris, Dubai and Istanbul where the incumbent airlines have better offerings. But you get what you pay for, and the PP access costs about $30 and I recently paid a shocking 22 euros for a sandwich in Madrid airport at a gate where there was no PP lounge.Would I buy Priority Pass on its own? Probably not. I'm conditioned to think of this as a credit card benefit and that is obviously PP's main business. I have several premium card options that include both Priority Pass and their main competitor, and I have Star Alliance Gold so I just see PP as a nice bonus to have depending where I am travelling to.

Fair for those passengers, I guess, but we felt that we paid for something that wasn’t delivered.It would be nice, as more people are using (and paying) for Priority Pass credentials,  that more lounges would be added to the list of partners.

My feedback would be to keep up the good work in general, but I’d strongly recommend improving the air conditioning and internet services at those two locations.

title: Priority Pass lounges are great when travelling with family
review: I almost always use a lounge when I travel and my experiences since 2012 when I first started using Priority Pass has been mostly positive.  There have been times when I was refused admittance to a lounge due to space limitation.  Sometimes I chose to wait and the wait was not long, while other times I chose to go elsewhere.  All the lounges that I have visited were not bad; some were bigger than others and had a wider range of food and drink.  I mostly use lounges in Asian countries like Hong Kong, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan, and Thailand, but also in Canada.  My family of 4 usually go on 4 to 6 trips a year so our combined visits to Priority Pass lounges can be quite high.  Having access to Priority Pass lounges is important to us and definitely preferable to waiting in crowded departure lounges.

title: Access denied too frequently
review: Sadly i have to say in my last 12 or 13 attempts to enter lounges the access was denied due to a supposed full capacity more than half of the times. It has happened in Al-Maha in Doha twice, 4 times in Premier Aeromexico, Aspire 41 in Amsterdam. The membership is too expensive for not being able to use it. In Al-Maha was possible to see from outside it was not full but Premier and Aspire 41 even refused to allow me to check and see if the place was really full. I was somehow accepting some inconvenience due to the postpandemic situation but now that most flights are usually full, I was hoping Priority Pass would be able to fix this discrimination pattern with their partners may be through a pre-booking system or something like that but that has not been the case. If this situation does not improve at the beginning of 2025 this will be my last year with Priority Pass as it doesn't make sense to pay for something I can hardly get.

Also, it added a £5 booking fee which didn't apply when I just booked the flight as a guest, so I ended up doing that instead. That said, flight cheaper on BudgetAir than some other booking providers.

title: The irony of scanning the sky but unable to scan the reviews
review: Skyscanner, I used your services for many years, which is why I'm giving you two stars in stead of only one. Many times when it did not really matter, things worked just fine, while only that single time when it mattered the most, I got screwed. The next time when the client gets suspicious about the booking agency you guys host, you better take it seriously and do not blindly side with the opposite party (just because you get more money from them than you get from me, because after all, it's because of me you are getting paid by them in the first place!), nor rely on your own reviews, which are by the way, unlike Trustpilot reviews, NOT transparent, and go about the Trustpilot reviews like these are not even serious or important. After all, your company is listed here as well, which is why you guys read right now what you read. You can find my correspondence with your agents under the reference number: "Skyscanner / #1115666" and read it for yourselves. Because of this Supersaver/KLM/Schwablands/drag-gueens joke, I had no chance to set things straight in time, so I had to book another ticket elsewhere, in order to see my mother one last time. But unfortunately she died before I could get to her, and I had no more money to book the 3d ticket in order to attend even her funeral. Which altogether brings me onto the following: I'm not that young anymore and I shall not travel very much in years to come, so it doesn't really matter to me personally.... but to you guys, all I have to say now, is that you maybe even deserve Klaus Schwab and the 4th Reich we're all witnessing manifest itself - as we speak. May the heavens have mercy on you. I also suggest you pay close attention, as your reviews may have the same destiny as those of Supersaver and KLM, and drop like a brick, before you even wink.

The whole trip was absolutely fabulous and probably the best we have had amongst all our many other travels to 50+ countries.  Our travel consultants were super helpful and custom built our itineraries in both countries to fit our needs and interests.  The local guides and drivers in both countries were all very attentive, professional, and were always there for us.  They surely know what excellent customer service means. All hotels were the best in their class and very comfortable and safe.  And to top that off, we received surprise souvenirs upon check in at each hotel from our consultants that ranged from handmade chocolates and delicacies to local handcrafted gifts with aromatic candles and cookbooks of local cuisines.  We are very impressed with this trip and will definitely be choosing Jacada for future destinations!

title: First Time in Puglia, not the last
review: Luisa, Anna and Alice at Jacada are very experienced and provided just the right mix of suggestions for us and queries about us. We flew in feeling confident that all would go smoothly, and we were not disappointed. Two of our three hotels (in Lecce and Ostuni) were gems to return to. We learned so much from our experienced guides as we toured amazing cities, and the olive estate and winery we visited were top-notch. It is hard to identify one highlight, but we really enjoyed our cooking class with Gianna in Lecce and the boat tour of sea caves at Polignano a Mare. We had asked to learn more about Jewish history in the area, and the highlight of that was being invited into a family's home to hear about its history and enjoy a splendid home -cooked and very elaborate aperitivo with them. Evening meals were booked at one excellent restaurant after another, and we barely did justice to the creative takes on traditional Puglia fare. Our one disappointment was that we did not spend time on the sea. Next time we will be clearer about breaking up the time with bouts of scheduled activities bookending a more relaxed, extended bit of time.

title: Had a wonderful trip
review: Had a wonderful trip. Jacada planned out our itinerary based on what we wanted to see and do. A bit pricier than other agencies, but wanted to give them a try. Most of it was good, but sometimes the attention to details was lacking until it was questioned or brought up. Also felt like our itinerary wasn't as thoughtful as we had hoped (like spending 3 hours on the road for a 1 hour location visit or visiting similar themes at multiple places). The hotels were very nice bt we didn't spend much time there since we were busy experiencing the new culture. Overall, the trip went well and it was nice to have Jacada take care of all the planning and details. Where they could use some improvement is in paying closer attention to all the details in the itinerary, planning and communications, especially when we are paying for a premium service (that we can get for less elsewhere).

title: Trip to New Zealand
review: The concierge listens to clients needs and responds quickly to questions before the trip and helps to build/adjust the itinerary according to our needs. Was a bit disappointed about one part of the trip which was suggested by them where we joined a boat tour going up and down the coast of Abel Tasman national park, we got up early and spent a full morning on a boat with many other passengers which stopped at multiple beaches for people to get on and off and then had a below average bbq lunch before getting off for a hike. The hike was great but we just wished we wouldn't have spent the whole morning sitting on the boat. We were obviously expecting something more tailor made to us. The tour guide hired was knowledgeable and helped us understand New Zealand more. He helped offer things to do when we cannot do things which were originally planned due to weather conditions.We had two scheduled helicopter tours but both got cancelled due to strong winds so that was disappointing, I think when planning the trip they should also try to include backup plans (where exactly to go if flight gets cancelled or potentially when can we try to go again) given the high cancellation chance of these heli tours. Our tour guide took us on a hike after our glacier heli ride was cancelled which was nice, but the sun was already setting when we did the hike, would have preferred doing it earlier in the day where there's sunlight and it would be better for photography. We could have gone earlier if we knew what the alternative was and the risk of those heli tour cancellations.

title: Overall Very Good but with some Unfortunate Surprises
review: We unfortunately had made plans and paid for travel to Kenya when COVID put the trip on a one year hiatus and then put  Jacada into bankruptcy.  It was very upsetting since we could get no information or return phone calls. It was not for many months, and after many attempts by phone and email, that a wonderful representative got back to us to say that the company had been restructured and that our contract with Jacada would be honored.  This was our son's safari honeymoon. We had made our own flight arrangements (which was a whole other mess in itself) and Jacada took care of the logistics and arrangements in Africa from the USA. The accommodations were fantastic. The staff were friendly.  Our son and daughter-in-law had a wonderful trip.  The negatives were: The original contract had an elephant orphanage visit included which was not included on the revised/delayed tour. We had to bring that to their attention.  There was a long delay between the Giraffe Manor hotel and their flight to Tanzania.  They were promised a driver and nice day of touring and lunch. The driver never showed up and the hotel's provided driver and tour were terrible. So much so that our family members asked to be taken to the airport early.  Their fight to Tanzania was delayed and once they arrived, the airport officials demanded that they be taken to a private room with 8 others to take a COVID test even though they had taken and paid for  COVID tests at the Giraffe Manor Hotel prior to departure.  The ride from the Tanzania Airport to Zanzibar was frightening, long, and very late at night.  The hotel in hotel and beach in Zanzibar were very nice but the food was not very good.  They also found out it made more sense to purchase their drink and food package than to pay for meals and drinks separately; a fact the Jacada should have known. It was unsafe and difficult to travel off-site of the resort. Both safari tours were excellent although there were many more animals at one over the other and the food at one was better than the other.

title: Africa Tour
review: Africa Tour1) Let me stress - the locations/hotels that were picked were spectacular.  We lucked into a few things in terms of what the animals were doing, etc but the hotels/camps/guides were wonderful and we truly had the vacation of a lifetime2) I acknowledge that Covid impacts everything - I also acknowledge when paying for a high end tour this is something that they need to adapt for3) This was NOT worry free -- I had to do a fair but of leg work regarding determine what kind of visa I needed, etc.  Again - not a big deal but when I fire off an email I would like to be able to get an answer from the team that's on the ground - and I recognize things are changing rapidly - but on at least 2 occasions I had to call countries consulates to get answers4) With the pandemic and with their recent adminstration/absorption into another company - it just seems that things were disorganized.  I am divorced and the trip was booked for myself and my two children (for a long period of time as it was originally scheduled for 2020).  I found out from a friend of mine 2 days before departure that I needed an affidavit from my ex so that I could freely travel (understandingly they are concerned people may be absconding with their children) - gratefully I was able to scramble but a) added a stress in days before leaving (and my own fault I had a busy schedule leading up to a long vacation) and b) if my friend didnt tell me this it would have been a disaster and we would have been hung up traveling the continent.5) Even little things weren't "tight" -- my international flight was cancelled/delayed 24 hours (NOT on Jacada - I get that) -- but when I went to notify them the 24 hour emergency number in my itinerary was not actually a 24 hour number (admittedly the true 24 hour number was in an email I had received but when the chips were down I picked up the itinerary that I had printed and called that number)With that said - when I had to fill out some other forms to get into Kenya (and this could not be done until I was already in Africa and had another negative covid test) the Kenya system was "down" - and I contacted Jacada and at the highest levels of the company they worked to have them for me in my email when I landed (truly fantastic). I think they get that all the changes (externally - pandemic - and internally - administration) have shaken things up and that they can (and I suspect will) do better.  And if you ever get to work with Clare in South Africa (might be Wilderness Safaris employee) consider yourself blessed - she is fantastic (Bags from US were lost and she tracked them down had them routed the right way -- among many achievements)I previously used Jacada for a trip to Australia 3 years ago and it was seem-less.  I also realize that a one country trip is probably easier but because of that experience and the wonderful itinerary they put together this time I went with them blindly again. title: We were generally happy with our trip…
review: We were generally happy with our trip as planned to Costa Rica but it was not as exceptional as I had hoped.  Upon arrival in San Jose we were supposed to be met by someone from Jacada with a Jacada sign with our name.  There are dozens of people waiting outside of arrival so it is a bit hectic, but our driver was not there when we arrived and it took perhaps 15-30 minutes to track him down.  Hotel in San Jose was very nice and a good selection.  Driver the next morning was on time and got us to our short plane flight to Puerto Jimenez which went fine.  Arrival in Puerto Jimenez was fine and we were greeted by Lapa Rios staff who were all outstanding.  Lapa Rios was the highlight of our trip.  Room was wonderful, staff were great, tours were fun.  Transfer back to Puerto Jimenez was fine.  Upon arrival back at San Jose we were once again waiting for driver to take us to El Silencio.  It was a short wait and the driver was very nice.  El Silencio is a nice lodge and we had excellent accommodations (although some maintenance issues with the room).  What we did not realize was how far it was from everything else we were doing.  The next day was a drive to the Arenal Hanging Bridges.  Holy crap it was over 2 hours away!  Why did they recommend a hotel that was so far from what we wanted to do?  The driver was nice and stopped and showed us some wildlife along the way.  After the hanging bridges we were supposed to do a volcano walk.  Unfortunately our driver had no idea what our itinerary was supposed to be and we had to try and call to figure out what we were supposed to do.  In the end we did a short hike at the volcano that was unimpressive.  The next day was zip lining and white water rafting.  It would have helped if Jacada had told us the name of the company we were doing this with.  A driver arrived who did not speak English and took us on an hour or so drive at break neck speed. The zip line and rafting guides from Pozo Azul were all very nice and we had a nice lunch as well.  Once again the same driver took us home and was probably the most death defying part of the day.  Transfer from El Silencio to the Guanacaste coast was fine, another long, four hour plus!, drive. Again the driver was nice, stopped for some food and a little site seeing along the way. We arrived at El Mangroove which was a nice hotel unfortunately, by this point the pandemic of Covid-19 was taking over everything.  The hotel was nearly vacant and our flight home was cancelled.  So after just one night at the hotel we decided we needed to beat it out of Costa Rica before they shut everything down.  In the end we had to cut our trip short by three days (of course this is not Jacada's fault). Last move was to call Jacada to have them rearrange our transport from the hotel back to the airport which they did but were all too fast to remind me that my hotel rooms were non-refundable.  So as noted, average.

title: Top Dollar for Disappointment
review: Excellent presentation, great concept, disappointing service beginning shortly after signing contract for our Thailand & Vietnam trip. Twice, our Jacada contact person unexpectedly changed or went on vacation without giving us notice in the middle of working out trip details. Communication became disjointed with these 3 different people, who didnt tell us they were in different time zones. Hoping for better communication at this level but not a dealbreaker, we were still very excited for our Jacada experience. The outstanding online reviews was quite reassuring.At US$18,000 for 2 people/11 days/ 3 cities we admittedly had high expectations. Our biggest expectation, aside from the accommodations, was that our guides would be excellent. (We are both seasoned, high and low-brow travelers looking for a down to earth, low impact, untouristy experience).Of 4 guides on our trip, our last one (in Hanoi) was wonderful. He had a lovely energy and showed us an inside view of local life, great insights to their culture/politics, locals only street food/restaurants, introduced us to family/friends, he didnt dominate our experience and completely enhanced it. The other 3 guides took us to soul-less 'tourists only' spots (think $kickbacks for bringing us to buy vendors overpriced fine jewelry, lacquerware, silk, art, furniture, etc.) We could have easily found these places on our own by following the packs of other Western tourists. We found these guides were uninspired or overbearing, listing off rote facts for a Western tourist stereotype and in the end, they were really just translators for the drivers. One guide repeatedly told us his fellow 'Vietnamese people are stupid' for one reason or another, which I found really sad. He lived in another city and didn't seem to know the town we were in. I've found better guides roadside in Nepal and Mongolia.We believed we were paying top dollar for the access to 'expert' local guides that were personally vetted by Jacada and would give us a memorable experience. As far as we could tell, they were all subcontracted from other guide agencies. The Thailand guide subcontractor that Jacada said to call for any issues didnt answer their phone or have voicemail when we called daytime to cancel a guide that we decided was taking away from our experience so much that we wanted to explore the city on our own. She was also missing when we arrived at the airport leaving us to call to see if there was a mix up with our schedule. Turns out she was sitting down chatting on the phone. We received an apology from Jacada w/ tickets to a show and a note saying let us know how your trip was when you return (in 8 days), which wasnt beginning to end service at all. Our memory of this time is fretting over whether to cancel each guide while weighing the economic impact on their families, or just tolerating the situation (aside from one, we chose the later and began pondering this review). We were so excited about our trip and believed we were in good hands as Jacada sells itself as luxury, curated travel and charge well for it. They have placed the bar high, but in our experience they unfortunately failed to reach it because of the guides whose hands they placed us in and their lack of follow through. Aside from these things, we had a lovely trip.We found the hotel concierges far better, more in-the-know with local recommendations than our guides and decided our next trip, we will just book the luxury hotels and utilize the services of their concierge.It's good to know there have been so many positive experiences. I felt a responsibility to review our experience for others to be aware that not all Jacada experiences are 5 star. On a better note, the Jacada staff were all very friendly, gave us solid city recommendations, did an excellent job of booking last minute spa services, hotel accommodations, getting visas, and setting up activities.

title: The review is mixed
review: The review is mixed.  First the positive.  1. Booking the trip was exciting and positive, well planned out, personal phone calls, pleasant to deal with, attention to detail, great accommodations chosen.  Everything went well with the initial booking, Trip was booked to Peru and the Galapagos for around 15000 per person x family of three (two adults and 17 year old boy)2. Experienced a strike in Peru.  This is where things got interesting.  We were not advised of strikes occurring in advance of our trip but I guess that was our responsibility to know.  They are not mentioned much on the internet as tourists may stop coming to Peru.  We were staying in the Sacred Valley and left at 5 am for a tour at the other end of the valley.  Our guide warned us of a possible strike that day and advised that it would likely be over by afternoon.  We did our morning tour and then waited for over an hour to be picked up by our guide (who was late).  We were booked for a gourmet lunch, but all the restaurants were closed up (lunch cancelled).  We were given some snack foods and stayed in the van until around 3:30 pm.  At that time, we attempted to get back to the hotel, and the roads were blocked.  No plan was in place, After much discussion on how to get back to the hotel, we set out walking (guide suggested), not realizing it was close to 50-60 km.  We walked for a long time.  I was offered a motorbike ride by "a friend" of the guide, which I declined as I was in Peru and would have to leave my child and husband.  We then hitch hiked with various people the guide knew and were told to pay money to each of them.  By nightfall, we had been walking for almost 3-4 hours.  We were then picked up by another car (dark by now) and left in a back alley with no explanation.  We walked down to the street where tires where being lit on fire and people were yelling and drinking.  We then found the guide who was in the crowd of people and rode in tuktuks (paying money for each of these) Finally, we got back to the hotel around 10:00 pm and were told that we had to check out at 3:00 am to drive back to make Ollantaytambo in the morning before the strike started again.  We had no supper, and no lunch and walked for 3-4 hours.  When we emailed Jacada, we were told that we were experiencing "the culture" of the country and that we should be thankful that they were assuming the costs to keep the guide close to us at our hotel.  ??Where was he going to go with all the roads blocked at 10:00 pm.  At 5 am, we got to the other end of the sacred valley and the guide found us some bread from his house for something to eat. We had paid for breakfasts at our hotel, but missed these because we left at 5 am and then checked out at 3 am.  The hotel did not provide coffee or anything to eat.  We then waited to take the train to Machu Pichu as we had deluxe accommodations up at the town.  The strike continued for two days, so the train did not run and we were placed in an alternate hotel of considerably less value.  We were provided with some meal coupons from a set menu which gave us 2 options.  We missed one day at the site as well.  When I expressed my dissatisfaction with these three days of "luxury" vacation, I was told that that is why I should get travel insurance.  FYI, travel insurance does not cover expenses related to civil unrest and I was not offered a discount or reimbursement on any of our costs. I was disappointed in how this was handled.  3. The rest of the hotels chosen were very nice, the guide did the best he could in bad conditions, the Galapagos vacation was well organized, the food was good, and the people of Peru were gracious and welcoming.Unfortunately, I would not travel with Jacada again, due to their response to the strike. We paid a considerable amount per person and experienced a regrettable event.  However, the company had our payment and we had to deal with the events on our own and accept "this happens".  Where does the money go that we paid for the "luxury hotel with meals" when we are put in a 2 star hotel? I believe strikes occur quite frequently in Peru and perhaps this needs to be broached before trips are arranged for people.  Our "luxury" vacation was certainly memorable but not for the right reasons!!

title: Disappointing trip to Chile organised by Jacada
review: Honestly - nice package and were left hanging dry to fend for ourselves to make the best out of it once we arrived in Chile for a 2 week vacation 2 years in the making. Had all the hall marks of focusing on the sale only. In essence, Jacada did the packaging and left the fulfillment to a local tour operator. We arrived in Chile, went to the wine region, and were for practical purposes stuck in the winery/hotel if we hadn't booked non-English speaking taxi ourselves and organised tours. Same thing happened in Patagonia except worse as it was high season there and no English speaking drivers/guides available with short notice, ie we again adhoc had to source driver rather than having anything suggested/planned in advance - after all, the tour was two years in preparation and we had never been there before therefore not knowing what to expect; that was exactly why for the first time had chosen a tour operator. Same thing repeated during visit to Atacama. Only Santiago worked out alright as difficult to mess up a city visit (again, we had to arrange for our own guide there). For a company that prides and sells itself as "luxury" there's a long way to go - i would hate to experience what a non-luxury tour operator would be like...during the trip, repeated calls to Jacada didnt result in anything other than "we are sorry, we are trying to xyz...." - nothing ever materialized other than excuses and apologies. Will never use them again. Long story short, we would have been better off - and cheaper - by organising the whole trip ourselves and would have had better quality guides/trips in Patagonia, Atacama and wine region as a result. i received an email from Jacada asking me to fill out this review - it's one year since we went and we still have a bad taste.

title: Overpriced, misrepresented, disorganized mess
review: I hope our experience would help someone else not make the same mistake we did by hiring Jacada. I got in touch with Jacada to help plan a holiday trip to New Zealand for two due to all the positive reviews here. We paid Jacada ~$105K USD (excluding roundtrip international flights) for a 16 day trip, where the estimated value of this itinerary is less than $65K USD by referencing hotel rates for the same dates and advertised tour prices online. We knew we were paying a high premium for their service, but they advertised local expertise and a seamless experience, so we thought it would be worth it.Our actual experience following full payment consists of the following facts:1. They took a long time (a week+ no update) to respond to our simple questions re activity details and hike recommendations. We ended up doing most of the research ourselves and telling them which hikes to book. It took them weeks to confirm a massage treatment for us when the hotel had an online form.2. They messed up planning our itinerary, changing a hike when we requested to add a hike through email. We only found out about the mistake after personally reaching out to the hotel that hosts these activities. 3. They quoted us 500 USD for changing the hike with the hotel. While confirming activities with said hotel, the hotel informed us the prices of the two hikes we wanted, with a difference of only 450 NZD ($255 USD). We reached out to Jacada for an explanation, they claimed it was human error and that their ops team would have caught the mistake eventually. 4. We changed our itinerary initially to stay an extra night in Auckland instead of an expensive hotel in Christchurch. We expected ~$2000 back due to hotel cost change and 1 removed day tour, but they only refunded us ~$890 (which took weeks to process). We asked repeatedly for an itemized cost breakdown of our itinerary, but they refuse to provide one because they say they are a tour operator instead of a travel agent.5. We reached out to their management due to all the aforementioned issues we encountered during trip planning. They apologized and offered to upgrade a hotel room for 2 nights which we declined because we thought it was insufficient to make us feel good about the mess. They made many excuses such as time difference and coordination with local teams. However our emails to the hotels were always responded to within a business day, way less than the delays we experienced with Jacada.6. During the trip, one of our 3.5hr helicopter tour had to be changed due to weather. Their NZ partner Southern Crossings called us while we were in the middle of a tour to tell us they would rebook us that afternoon from 4-6PM, they promised to refund us for the flight difference but wouldn’t know the amount until the tour is over. We were rushed into this helicopter tour and it ended up being just 1.5hr (43% of the originally scheduled 3.5hr tour). The next day when we reached out to Southern Crossings to follow up on the refund amount, we were informed they could not provide this information and we had to refer to Jacada, contrary to what they told us the day before. After many email exchanges Jacada was finally able to confirm a refund of ~1900 NZD, which is only 16% of the estimated cost of this tour at ~$12K NZD (based on a similar tour offered by the same helicopter company, we don’t know the actual cost because Jacada refuses to provide itemized cost). Jacada couldn’t provide an explanation on how the refund was calculated besides that it’s a “bespoke tour”so it’s priced differently. 7. Jacada booked us on a hike that we never asked for and was never in our itinerary. We were caught by surprise when the guide showed up at our hotel and called repeatedly on our cell and the hotel phone while we were trying to rest after a long morning. Jacada/their local partner clearly messed up our itinerary and offered no apology. 8. Jacada asked for our height and weight for the helicopter tours and collected our medical info. This sensitive info along with our full names and birth dates were then inserted almost verbatim into a document and shared with the hotels without our explicit consent (illegal per state and UK laws) and regardless of relevancy. None of the hotels were involved in the heli tour. We found out because we received a hard copy of this document addressed from Jacada to hotel staff in our hotel room by mistake. A complete violation of privacy, just like how they’ve responded to anonymous reviews here with clients’ names. The estimated 60% markup they charged on our trip is absurd given all the issues we’ve encountered, not to mention the gross violation of privacy disclosing our medical info without consent to third parties. To refund 16% for a 43% completed heli tour is a scam — Jacada basically threw us to the wolves.

title: We took a 10 day trip to Kenya

title: Moroccan horror presented by Jacada…
review: Moroccan horror presented by Jacada TravelsJacada Travels describes itself as “Discover the world with Jacada's private luxury tour”I tried them for the first time for our trip to Morocco. I was met by Jack Bedford. A slick salesman.  He promised everything and more and sold a 8 night program to me for a fortune. Like all travel companies they ask for the complete tour payment upfront. As soon as I remitted the amounts I got an ‘out of office’ response from Jack and he disappeared from the scene. A few days later I was met by Sabina Munoz, who started preparing an itinerary different from what Jack promised. Jacada is very clever as they never circulate a pdf version of the agreed itinerary, instead they circulate a web url, where in the new comments overwrite  earlier comments. Therefore there was no way of cross checking what Jack promised. Eventually we had an itinerary different in many places from what Jack promised. The night before I was to leave for Morocco I got an email from Sabina stating the Riad at Fez for which I had paid was sold out and some other hotel was being booked for me. I screamed  and shouted over email and only then did they confirm my stay at the Riad at Fez.The tour guide they arranged didn’t know our itinerary and had factual gaps in his knowledge.The itinerary prepared by Sabina was not clear whether lunch was included in the cost which caused more confusion than clarity. For a food tour (which was included in the itinerary) experience we were told that a “food tour” meant sitting in one restaurant and trying different Morocon cuisine. The travel company  would identify this restaurant, but we had to pay for the food. As you can imagine by now the legalese of the itinerary was giving us a nightmare.The crowning glory was our stay at Kasba Bab Ourika. We had a flight out late in the night and Sabina had sent an email stating we had a late checkout at 6 pm on the day of our departure. The night before we left we started getting persistent calls from the hotel management that we had to vacate the next day at 12 noon We directed them to Jacada travels but the hotel management kept harassing us and Jacada travel went silent. In the morning the hotel manager and her cronies came to our door to physically evacuate us ( Photos attached). They first contested whether we had any factual evidence of a late checkout. When we showed them the email.  They said too bad you have to vacate. So we were thrown out of our rooms. Jacada travels had disappeared by then, except for a few emails from Alesha Walton where in she went to the legalese of late check out and deviate from the earlier commitment of a late check out. Our only contact with the travel company thereafter being the chauffeur.  Everyone made money on our trip, Jacada travels, their local travel company,  Kasba  Bab Ourika and we were thrown out of our rooms almost twelve hours before our flight in spite of paying top dollars.Use Jaccada travels if you would like to willingly get robbed and be abondened. They price themselves as “bespoke” but they treat you like a courier package. Beware of the people I mentioned. They are modern day muggers in the tourist industry.

title: Just a pure nightmare
review: *Submitting new as I cannot edit the old one for some reason. I made an enquiry for India and was matched with Travel Designer called Ellie. She didn’t send necessary information by the deadline she set herself, and i had to chase her and point out her faults for her to finally apologize and acknowledge her mistakes.When I asked to work with another travel designer, she actively ignored me to the point I had to make brand new enquiry through their website just to get hold of someone else from Jacada.After explaining the incident several times, Seema (apparently head of travel design) contacted me and told me that the reason Ellie wanted to deal with the situation herself was because "she felt a connection" with me after a phone call...She also told me someone else was preparing my itinerary, just to be told few hours later that they have decided not to continue arranging my trip… because they are not confident they can turn my experience around anymore.After submitting my first review here and there, they posted a lengthly and winy reply, saying that they were willing to chat to resolve my frustrations and that they are willing to try restore my faith in Jacada, despite ignoring my emails and a phone call. So I sent another email to Seema asking for the contact details of Phil (apparently head of sales), as he was mentioned in their review reply as their new contact point.When Phil and I spoke on the phone, he stated that his colleagues felt they were unable to satisfy my needs after I turned down a phone call request and asked them to communicate via email, and said that also because my sentences in those emails were short.When I asked what he meant by wishing to regain my faith in Jacada when they did not try to reconcile privately, he yelled "why do you think I am on this phone call?...who else is gonna know that we are having this phone conversation?".He went on to say that it was Jacada's company policy that they do not work with potential clients who refuse to speak on the phone on a regular basis. When I asked where on their website this policy was stated, he said "it is not a legal requirement to state every company policy on its website". I explained to him that not only it was clearly stated on their website, no one from the company explained that this was mandatory requirement for their client to oblige in order to get their trips arranged.He then went on and said that as long as I was willing to speak on the phone regularly with them, he was willing to have his staff to arrange recommendations and itinerary drafts for me. By that point I hung up the phone (I am glad that I had recorded our phone conversation).Pretty passive aggressive response,  and I wish I could share the recorded conversation and email correspondence with here because they would be self explanatory how unprofessional and inconsistent their service is.

title: Booked a weekend away at Mersea Island
review: Booked a weekend away at Mersea Island. We wasn't expecting half of what we got when we arrived.I firstly booked a basic caravan, then noticed we had been upgraded to a luxury caravan.Heating was already on when we arrived which was a plus point, accommodation was lovely and clean, washing up accessories provided.. my 18 year old dog loved his welcome box.I didn't know that the onsite facilities wouldn't be open, so I googled well in advance what was in the area. There is a lovely pub nearby called the Dog & Pheasant, good food and at an affordable price.We only meant to use the caravan as a base, but for the price paid, away resorts have gone above and beyond.I myself have worked in tourism for 20 years and I will say, if you have an issue with your accommodation report it straight away. If not much is open, have a look online at what's in the area. It's only you that can make your holiday, so make the best of it!

title: We loved it so much we are coming back

So a huge thank you again to all the staff at Barmouth Bay  Thank you from his grateful Mum Viv

title: Birthday celebration …

It was difficult to get into the children’s evening entertainment, book activities, find a table to eat etc. The swimming pool desperately needs some tlc. It was tatty, crowded & needed a thorough clean.
